// When converting arrays to string using Array.prototype.toString or Array.prototype.join, the
// rules for conversion to String are different than converting each element individually.
// Specifically, "null" and "undefined" are converted to an empty string.
// 
// Param: n A node that is a member of an Array.
// Returns: The string representation.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:190
func GetArrayElementStringValue(n *rhino.Node) string {
	return func() any { if NodeUtil.IsNullOrUndefined(n) || n.IsEmpty() { return "" }; return GetStringValue(n) }()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:194
func ArrayToString(literal *rhino.Node) string {
	first := literal.GetFirstChild()
	result := NewStringBuilder()
	for n := first; n != nil; n = n.GetNext() {
		childValue := GetArrayElementStringValue(n)
		if childValue == nil {
			return nil
		}
		if n != first {
			result.Append(',')
		}
		result.Append(childValue)
	}
	return result.ToString()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:310
func GetStringNumberValue(rawJsString string) Double {
	if rawJsString.Contains("\u000b") {
		return nil
	}
	s := TrimJsWhiteSpace(rawJsString)
	if s.IsEmpty() {
		return 0.0
	}
	if s.Length() > 2 && s.CharAt(0) == '0' && s.CharAt(1) == 'x' || s.CharAt(1) == 'X' {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				_ = r // was: NumberFormatException e
				return Double.NaN
			}
		}()
		return Double.ValueOf(Integer.ParseInt(s.Substring(2), 16))
	}
	if s.Length() > 3 && s.CharAt(0) == '-' || s.CharAt(0) == '+' && s.CharAt(1) == '0' && s.CharAt(2) == 'x' || s.CharAt(2) == 'X' {
		return nil
	}
	if s.Equals("infinity") || s.Equals("-infinity") || s.Equals("+infinity") {
		return nil
	}
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			_ = r // was: NumberFormatException e
			return Double.NaN
		}
	}()
	return Double.ParseDouble(s)
}

// Gets the value of a node as a BigInt, or null if it cannot be converted. When it returns a

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:408
func GetStringBigIntValue(rawJsString string) BigInteger {
	if rawJsString.Contains("\u000b") {
		return nil
	}
	s := TrimJsWhiteSpace(rawJsString)
	if s.IsEmpty() {
		return BigInteger.ZERO
	}
	if s.Length() > 2 && s.CharAt(0) == '0' {
		radix := Switch(s.CharAt(1))
		if radix != 0 {
			defer func() {
				if r := recover(); r != nil {
					_ = r // was: NumberFormatException e
					return nil
				}
			}()
			return NewBigInteger(s.Substring(2), radix)
		}
	}
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			_ = r // was: NumberFormatException e
			return nil
		}
	}()
	return NewBigInteger(s)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:444
func TrimJsWhiteSpace(s string) string {
	start := 0
	end := s.Length()
	for end > 0 && TokenUtil.IsStrWhiteSpaceChar(s.CharAt(end - 1)) == Tri.TRUE {
		end--
	}
	for start < end && TokenUtil.IsStrWhiteSpaceChar(s.CharAt(start)) == Tri.TRUE {
		start++
	}
	return s.Substring(start, end)
}

// Param: n A function or class node.
// Returns: The name of the given function or class, if it has one.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:460
func GetName(n *rhino.Node) string {
	nameNode := GetNameNode(n)
	return func() any { if nameNode == nil { return nil }; return nameNode.GetQualifiedName() }()
}

// Gets the node of a function or class's name. This method recognizes five forms:
// 
// <ul>
//   <li>{@code class name {...}}
//   <li>{@code var name = class {...}}
//   <li>{@code qualified.name = class {...}}
//   <li>{@code var name2 = class name1 {...}}
//   <li>{@code qualified.name2 = class name1 {...}}
// </ul>
// 
// In two last cases with named function expressions, the second name is returned (the variable or
// qualified name).
// 
// Param: n A function or class node
// Returns: the node best representing the class's name
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:482
func GetNameNode(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(n.IsFunction() || n.IsClass(), n)
	parent := n.GetParent()
	switch parent.GetToken() {
	}
}

// Set the given function/class node to an empty name
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:512
func RemoveName(n *rhino.Node) {
	CheckState(n.IsFunction() || n.IsClass())
	originalName := n.GetFirstChild()
	emptyName := func() any { if n.IsFunction() { return IR.Name("") }; return IR.Empty() }()
	originalName.ReplaceWith(emptyName.Srcref(originalName))
}

// Gets the function's name. This method recognizes the forms:
// 
// <ul>
//   <li>{@code &#123;'name': function() ...&#125;}
//   <li>{@code &#123;name: function() ...&#125;}
//   <li>{@code function name() ...}
//   <li>{@code var name = function() ...}
//   <li>{@code var obj = {name() {} ...}}
//   <li>{@code qualified.name = function() ...}
//   <li>{@code var name2 = function name1() ...}
//   <li>{@code qualified.name2 = function name1() ...}
// </ul>
// 
// Param: n a node whose type is {@link Token#FUNCTION}
// Returns: the function's name, or {@code null} if it has no name
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:536
func GetNearestFunctionName(n *rhino.Node) string {
	if !n.IsFunction() {
		return nil
	}
	name := GetName(n)
	if name != nil {
		return name
	}
	parent := n.GetParent()
	return Switch(parent.GetToken())
}

	return n.GetLastChild()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:561
func GetEs6ClassConstructorMemberFunctionDef(classNode *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckArgument(classNode.IsClass(), classNode)
	classMembers := CheckNotNull(classNode.GetLastChild(), classNode)
	for memberFunctionDef := classMembers.GetFirstChild(); memberFunctionDef != nil; memberFunctionDef = memberFunctionDef.GetNext() {
		if IsEs6ConstructorMemberFunctionDef(memberFunctionDef) {
			return memberFunctionDef
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Returns true if this is a literal value. We define a literal value as any node that evaluates
// to the same thing regardless of when or where it is evaluated. So /xyz/ and [3, 5] are
// literals, but the name a is not.
// 
// <p>Function literals do not meet this definition, because they lexically capture variables. For
// example, if you have <code>
// function() { return a; }
// </code> If it is evaluated in a different scope, then it captures a different variable. Even if
// the function did not read any captured variables directly, it would still fail this definition,
// because it affects the lifecycle of variables in the enclosing scope.
// 
// <p>However, a function literal with respect to a particular scope is a literal.
// 
// Param: includeFunctions If true, all function expressions will be treated as literals.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:663
func IsLiteralValue(n *rhino.Node, includeFunctions bool) bool {
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
}

// Returns the closureUnaware function body within a script modelling a shadow AST
// 
// <p>TranspileAndOptimizeClosureUnaware pass models each @closureUnaware block as a function
// body, and will throw a runtime exception if any pass inserts new code outside that function
// body. So we sometimes need to map from an actual script node to the
// corresponding @closureUnaware script-esque block.
// 
// <p>TODO: lharker - if we end up needing this special logic often, consider instead making
// TranspileAndOptimizeclosureUnaware support inserting code at the script level.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:763
func FindClosureUnawareScriptRoot(script *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckArgument(script.IsScript() && script.GetIsInClosureUnawareSubtree(), script)
	return NodeUtil.FindPreorder(script, Node, c - > true)
}

// Returns the node within the given block at which something can be inserted such that it's after
// all inner function declarations in that block. We want this because normalization expects all
// inner function declarations to be hoisted. If there's not good insertion point (e.g. the block
// is empty or only contains inner function declarations), return null.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:774
func GetInsertionPointAfterAllInnerFunctionDeclarations(block *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(block.IsBlock())
	current := block.GetFirstChild()
	for current != nil && NodeUtil.IsFunctionDeclaration(current) {
		current = current.GetNext()
	}
	return current
}

// Returns true iff the value associated with the node is a JS string literal, a concatenation
// thereof or a ternary operator choosing between string literals.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:788
func IsSomeCompileTimeConstStringValue(node *rhino.Node) bool {
	if node.IsStringLit() || node.IsTemplateLit() && node.HasOneChild() {
		return true
	} else if node.IsAdd() {
		CheckState(node.HasTwoChildren(), node)
		left := node.GetFirstChild()
		right := node.GetLastChild()
		return IsSomeCompileTimeConstStringValue(left) && IsSomeCompileTimeConstStringValue(right)
	} else if node.IsHook() {
		left := node.GetSecondChild()
		right := node.GetLastChild()
		return IsSomeCompileTimeConstStringValue(left) && IsSomeCompileTimeConstStringValue(right)
	}
	return false
}

// Returns whether this a BLOCK node with no children.
// 
// Param: block The node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:811
func IsEmptyBlock(block *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !block.IsBlock() {
		return false
	}
	for n := block.GetFirstChild(); n != nil; n = n.GetNext() {
		if !n.IsEmpty() {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// @const * / goog.math
// = goog.math || {};
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:942
func IsNamespaceDecl(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	jsdoc := GetBestJSDocInfo(n)
	if jsdoc != nil && !jsdoc.GetTypeNodes().IsEmpty() && !jsdoc.HasTypedefType() {
		return false
	}
	isMarkedConst := n.GetParent().IsConst() || jsdoc != nil && jsdoc.IsConstant()
	if !n.IsFromExterns() && !isMarkedConst {
		return false
	}
	var qnameNode *rhino.Node
	var initializer *rhino.Node
	if NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(n.GetParent()) {
		qnameNode = n
		initializer = n.GetFirstChild()
	} else if n.IsExprResult() {
		expr := n.GetFirstChild()
		if !expr.IsAssign() || !expr.GetFirstChild().IsGetProp() {
			return false
		}
		qnameNode = expr.GetFirstChild()
		initializer = expr.GetLastChild()
	} else if n.IsGetProp() {
		parent := n.GetParent()
		if !parent.IsAssign() || !parent.GetParent().IsExprResult() {
			return false
		}
		qnameNode = n
		initializer = parent.GetLastChild()
	} else {
		return false
	}
	if initializer == nil || qnameNode == nil {
		return false
	}
	if initializer.IsObjectLit() {
		return true
	}
	return initializer.IsOr() && qnameNode.MatchesQualifiedName(initializer.GetFirstChild()) && initializer.GetLastChild().IsObjectLit()
}

// Determine if the given SCRIPT is a @typeSummary file, like an i.js file
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:991
func IsFromTypeSummary(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	CheckArgument(n.IsScript(), n)
	info := n.GetJSDocInfo()
	return info != nil && info.IsTypeSummary()
}

	}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1071
func AllArgsUnescapedLocal(callOrNew *rhino.Node) bool {
	for arg := callOrNew.GetSecondChild(); arg != nil; arg = arg.GetNext() {
		if !EvaluatesToLocalValue(arg) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1098
func CanBeSideEffected(n *rhino.Node, knownConstants map[string]struct{}, scope *TypedScope) bool {
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
	for c := n.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
		if CanBeSideEffected(c, knownConstants, scope) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1470

}

// Return if the node is possibly a string.
// 
// Param: n The node.
// Param: useType If true and the node has a primitive type, return true if that type is string
//     and false otherwise.
// Returns: Whether the results is possibly a string.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1482
func MayBeString(n *rhino.Node, useType bool) bool {
	if useType {
		color := n.GetColor()
		if color != nil {
			if color.Equals(StandardColors.STRING) {
				return true
			} else if color.Equals(StandardColors.NUMBER) || color.Equals(StandardColors.BIGINT) || color.Equals(StandardColors.BOOLEAN) || color.Equals(StandardColors.NULL_OR_VOID) {
				return false
			}
		}
		typ := n.GetJSType()
		if typ != nil {
			if typ.IsStringValueType() {
				return true
			} else if typ.IsNumberValueType() || typ.IsBigIntValueType() || typ.IsBooleanValueType() || typ.IsNullType() || typ.IsVoidType() {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return MayBeString(GetKnownValueType(n))
}

// Returns: Whether the results is possibly a string, this includes Objects which may implicitly be
//     converted to a string.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1515

	return Switch(typ)
}

}

// Returns true if the operator is associative. e.g. (a * b) * c = a * (b * c) Note: "+" is not
// associative because it is also the concatenation for strings. e.g. "a" + (1 + 2) is not "a" + 1
// + 2. Multilication is not associative because it can include floating point numbers. </pre>
// 
// e.g. 1e-300 * 1e300 * 1e9 does not equal 1e-300 * (1e300 * 1e9). </pre>
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1540
func IsAssociative(typ rhino.Token) bool {
	return Switch(typ)
}

// Returns true if the operator is commutative. e.g. (a * b) * c = c * (b * a) Note 1: "+" is not
// commutative because it is also the concatenation for strings. e.g. "a" + (1 + 2) is not "a" + 1
// + 2 Note 2: only operations on literals and pure functions are commutative.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1552
func IsCommutative(typ rhino.Token) bool {
	return Switch(typ)
}

// Returns true if the operator is an assignment type operator. Note: The logical assignments
// (i.e. ASSIGN_OR, ASSIGN_AND, ASSIGN_COALESCE) follow short-circuiting behavior, and the RHS may
// not always be evaluated. They are still considered AssignmentOps (may be optimized).
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1564
func IsAssignmentOp(n *rhino.Node) bool {

}

func IsLogicalAssignmentOp(n *rhino.Node) bool {

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1599

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1674

	return GetEnclosingFunction(n) != nil

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1682
func GetEnclosingNode(n *rhino.Node, pred Predicate<Node>) *rhino.Node {
	curr := n
	for curr != nil && !pred.Apply(curr) {
		curr = curr.GetParent()
	}
	return curr
}

// Returns: The first property in the objlit or class members, that matches the key.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1693
func GetFirstPropMatchingKey(n *rhino.Node, keyName string) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(n.IsObjectLit() || n.IsClassMembers())
	for keyNode := n.GetFirstChild(); keyNode != nil; keyNode = keyNode.GetNext() {
		if keyNode.IsStringKey() || keyNode.IsMemberFunctionDef() && keyNode.GetString().Equals(keyName) {
			return keyNode.GetFirstChild()
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Returns: The first getter in the class members that matches the key.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1707
func GetFirstGetterMatchingKey(n *rhino.Node, keyName string) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(n.IsClassMembers() || n.IsObjectLit(), n)
	for keyNode := n.GetFirstChild(); keyNode != nil; keyNode = keyNode.GetNext() {
		if keyNode.IsGetterDef() && keyNode.GetString().Equals(keyName) {
			return keyNode
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Returns {@code true} if this function references its receiver object.
// 
// <p>We define this function in terms of "receiver" rather than specific syntax, however
// internally we search for `this` and `super`.
// 
// <p>Arrow functions return {@code false}. They do not have their own receiver, but rather
// capture the receiver of the enclosing scope.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1726
func ReferencesOwnReceiver(fn *rhino.Node) bool {
	CheckState(fn.IsFunction())
	if fn.IsArrowFunction() {
		return false
	}
	return ReferencesEnclosingReceiver(NodeUtil.GetFunctionParameters(fn)) || ReferencesEnclosingReceiver(NodeUtil.GetFunctionBody(fn))
}

// Returns {@code true} if this subtree references the receiver object from its enclosing function
// scope.
// 
// <p>We define this function in terms of "receiver" rather than specific syntax, however
// internally we search for `this` and `super`.
// 
// <p>Arrow functions may return {@code true}. They capture the receiver of the enclosing scope,
// rather than having their own.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1746
func ReferencesEnclosingReceiver(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return Has(n, c - > c.isThis() || c.isSuper(), MATCH_ANYTHING_BUT_NON_ARROW_FUNCTION)
}

// Returns true if the current scope contains references to the 'super' keyword. Note that if
// there are classes declared inside the current class, super calls which reference those classes
// are not reported.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1755
func ReferencesSuper(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	curr := n.GetFirstChild()
	for curr != nil {
		if Has(curr, Node, node - > !node.isClass()) {
			return true
		}
		curr = curr.GetNext()
	}
	return false
}

// Is this a GETPROP, OPTCHAIN_GETPROP, GETELEM, or OPTCHAIN_GETELEM?

func IsNormalOrOptChainGet(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return IsNormalGet(n) || IsOptChainGet(n)

func IsNormalOrOptChainCall(n *rhino.Node) bool {

func IsNormalGet(n *rhino.Node) bool {

}

// Is this an OPTCHAIN_GETPROP or OPTCHAIN_GETELEM node?

func IsOptChainGet(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsOptChainGetProp() || n.IsOptChainGetElem()

// Is this a OPTCHAIN_GETPROP, OPTCHAIN_GETELEM, OPTCHAIN_CALL node?
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1792
func IsOptChainNode(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsOptChainGetProp() || n.IsOptChainGetElem() || n.IsOptChainCall()
}

// Find the start of the optional chain. E.g Find the `a?. ...` node in `a?.b.c.d` given any other
// node
// 
// Param: n A node in an optional chain
// Returns: The start of the optional chain that `n` is part of.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1803
func GetStartOfOptChainSegment(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(NodeUtil.IsOptChainNode(n), n)
	if n.IsOptionalChainStart() {
		return n
	}
	return GetStartOfOptChainSegment(n.GetFirstChild())
}

// Find the end of an optional chain segment.
// 
// <p>Each `?.` ends one segment and starts another.
// 
// <p>Examples
// 
// <pre>
//   a?.b.c.d   // end is the node with children `a?.b.c` and `d`
//   a?.b.c?.d  // given a?.b end is the node with children `a?.b` and `c`
//   a?.b.c?.d  // given a?.b.c end is the node with children `a?.b.c` and `d`
//   (a?.b.c).d // given a?.b end is the node with children `a?.b` and `c`
// </pre>
// 
// Param: n A node in an optional chain
// Returns: The end of the optional chain that `n` is part of.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1828
func GetEndOfOptChainSegment(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(NodeUtil.IsOptChainNode(n), n)
	if IsEndOfOptChainSegment(n) {
		return n
	} else {
		return GetEndOfOptChainSegment(n.GetParent())
	}
}

// Is this node the final node of a full optional chain?
// 
// <p>e.g. for `a?.b.c?.d` this method returns true only for the Node with children `a?.b.c` and
// `d`. That node is the end of the whole chain, and also represents the whole chain in the AST.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1843
func IsEndOfFullOptChain(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if NodeUtil.IsOptChainNode(n) {
		parent := n.GetParent()
		return !NodeUtil.IsOptChainNode(parent) && n.IsFirstChildOf(parent)
	} else {
		return false
	}
}

// Is this node the end of an optional chain segment?
// 
// <p>Each `?.` begins a new segment and ends the previous one, if any. The end of the whole chain
// is also the end of its final segment.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1860
func IsEndOfOptChainSegment(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !NodeUtil.IsOptChainNode(n) {
		return false
	} else {
		parent := n.GetParent()
		if parent != nil && n.IsFirstChildOf(parent) && NodeUtil.IsOptChainNode(parent) {
			return parent.IsOptionalChainStart()
		} else {
			return true
		}
	}
}

// Given the end of an optional chain segment changes all nodes from the end down to the start
// into non-optional nodes. e.g `({a})?.a.b.c.d()?.x.y.z` gets converted to
// `({a}).a.b.c.d()?.x.y.z` when the passed in endOfOptChainSegment is `({a})?.a.b.c.d()`.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1884
func ConvertToNonOptionalChainSegment(endOfOptChainSegment *rhino.Node) {
	CheckArgument(IsEndOfOptChainSegment(endOfOptChainSegment), endOfOptChainSegment)
	segmentNodes := NewArrayDeque<>()
	segmentNode := endOfOptChainSegment
	for true {
		CheckState(NodeUtil.IsOptChainNode(segmentNode), segmentNode)
		segmentNodes.Add(segmentNode)
		if segmentNode.IsOptionalChainStart() {
			break
		}
		segmentNode = segmentNode.GetFirstChild()
	}
	for _, n := range segmentNodes {
		n.SetIsOptionalChainStart(false)
		n.SetToken(GetNonOptChainToken(n.GetToken()))
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1905
func getNonOptChainToken(optChainToken rhino.Token) rhino.Token {
	return Switch(optChainToken)
}

// Is this node a block-scoped declaration? Checks for let, const, class, or block-scoped function
// declarations.

// Returns: True if {@code n} is a block-scoped declaration statement.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1921
func IsBlockScopedDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {

}

// Is this node a name declaration?
// 
// Param: n The node
// Returns: True if {@code n} is VAR, LET or CONST
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1936
func IsNameDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n != nil && n.IsVar() || n.IsLet() || n.IsConst()
}

// Param: n The node
// Returns: True if {@code n} is a VAR, LET or CONST that contains a destructuring pattern.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1944
func IsDestructuringDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if IsNameDeclaration(n) {
		for c := n.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
			if c.IsDestructuringLhs() {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

// For an assignment or variable declaration get the assigned value.
// 
// Returns: The value node representing the new value.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:1960
func GetAssignedValue(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(n.IsName() || n.IsGetProp(), n)
	parent := n.GetParent()
	if NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(parent) {
		return n.GetFirstChild()
	} else if parent.IsAssign() && parent.GetFirstChild() == n {
		return n.GetNext()
	} else {
		return nil
	}
}

// Is this node an assignment expression statement?

// Returns: Whether the specified node has a loop parent that is within the current scope.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2028
func IsWithinLoop(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	for _, parent := range n.GetAncestors() {
		if NodeUtil.IsLoopStructure(parent) {
			return true
		}
		if parent.IsFunction() {
			break
		}
	}
	return false
}

// A block scope is created by a non-synthetic block node, a for loop node, or a for-of loop node.
// 
// <p>Note: for functions, we use two separate scopes for parameters and declarations in the body.
// We need to make sure default parameters cannot reference var / function declarations in the
// body.
// 
// Returns: Whether the node creates a block scope.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2111
func CreatesBlockScope(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2131
func CreatesScope(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return CreatesBlockScope(n) || n.IsFunction() || n.IsModuleBody() || n.IsMemberFieldDef() || n.IsComputedFieldDef() / / The ROOT nodes that are the root of the externs tree or main JS tree do not
        // create scopes. The parent of those two, which is the root of the entire AST and
        // therefore has no parent, is the only ROOT node that creates a scope.
        || (n.isRoot() && n.getParent() == null)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2146
func IsValidCfgRoot(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return DEFINITE_CFG_ROOTS.Contains(n.GetToken()) || IsClassStaticBlock(n)
}

// Returns: Whether the node is used as a statement.

func IsStatement(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return !n.IsModuleBody() && !n.IsScript() && !n.IsRoot() && IsStatementParent(n.GetParent())
}

// Whether the node is part of a switch statement.

}

// Returns: Whether the node is a reference to a variable, function, class or function parameter
//     (not a label or an empty function expression name).
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2189
func IsReferenceName(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsName() && !n.GetString().IsEmpty()
}

// Returns whether the given name in an import or export spec is not defined within the module,
// but is an exported name from this or another module.
// 
// <p>Examples include `nonlocal` in:
// 
// <ul>
//   <li>export {a as nonlocal};
//   <li>import {nonlocal} from './foo.js';
//   <li>import {nonlocal as a} from './foo.js';
//   <li>export {nonlocal as a} from './foo.js';
//   <li>export {a as nonlocal} from './foo.js';
// </ul>
// 
// Param: n a NAME node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2209
func IsNonlocalModuleExportName(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	CheckArgument(n.IsName(), n)
	parent := n.GetParent()
	if parent.IsImportSpec() && n.IsFirstChildOf(parent) {
		return true
	} else if parent.IsExportSpec() {
		if n.IsFirstChildOf(parent) {
			return IsExportFrom(parent.GetGrandparent())
		} else {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// Whether the child node is the FINALLY block of a try.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2228
func IsTryFinallyNode(parent *rhino.Node, child *rhino.Node) bool {
	return parent.IsTry() && parent.HasXChildren(3) && child == parent.GetLastChild()
}

// Whether the node is a CATCH container BLOCK.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2233
func IsTryCatchNodeContainer(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	return parent.IsTry() && parent.GetSecondChild() == n
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2239
func IsInSyntheticScript(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	sourceFileName := n.GetSourceFileName()
	return sourceFileName != nil && sourceFileName.StartsWith(" [synthetic:") || sourceFileName.StartsWith(AbstractCompiler.RUNTIME_LIB_DIR)
}

// Permanently delete the given node from the AST, as well as report the related AST
// changes/deletions to the given compiler.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2250
func DeleteNode(n *rhino.Node, compiler *Compiler) {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	NodeUtil.MarkFunctionsDeleted(n, compiler)
	n.Detach()
	compiler.ReportChangeToEnclosingScope(parent)
}

// Permanently delete the given call from the AST while maintaining a valid node structure, as
// well as report the related AST changes to the given compiler. In some cases, this is done by
// deleting the parent from the AST and is come cases expression is replaced by {@code undefined}.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2262
func DeleteFunctionCall(n *rhino.Node, compiler *Compiler) {
	CheckState(n.IsCall())
	parent := n.GetParent()
	if parent.IsExprResult() {
		grandParent := parent.GetParent()
		parent.Detach()
		parent = grandParent
	} else {
		n.ReplaceWith(NewUndefinedNode(n))
	}
	NodeUtil.MarkFunctionsDeleted(n, compiler)
	compiler.ReportChangeToEnclosingScope(parent)
}

// Permanently delete all the children of the given node, including reporting changes.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2280
func DeleteChildren(n *rhino.Node, compiler *Compiler) {
	for n.HasChildren() {
		DeleteNode(n.GetFirstChild(), compiler)
	}
}

// Safely remove children while maintaining a valid node structure. In some cases, this is done by
// removing the parent from the AST as well.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2290
func RemoveChild(parent *rhino.Node, node *rhino.Node) {
	if IsTryFinallyNode(parent, node) {
		if NodeUtil.HasCatchHandler(GetCatchBlock(parent)) {
			node.Detach()
		} else {
			node.DetachChildren()
		}
	} else if node.IsCatch() {
		tryNode := node.GetGrandparent()
		CheckState(NodeUtil.HasFinally(tryNode))
		node.Detach()
	} else if IsTryCatchNodeContainer(node) {
		tryNode := node.GetParent()
		CheckState(NodeUtil.HasFinally(tryNode))
		node.DetachChildren()
	} else if node.IsBlock() {
		node.DetachChildren()
	} else if IsStatementBlock(parent) || IsSwitchCase(node) || node.IsMemberFunctionDef() {
		node.Detach()
	} else if IsNameDeclaration(parent) || parent.IsExprResult() {
		if parent.HasMoreThanOneChild() {
			node.Detach()
		} else {
			node.Detach()
			RemoveChild(parent.GetParent(), parent)
		}
	} else if parent.IsLabel() && node == parent.GetLastChild() {
		node.Detach()
		RemoveChild(parent.GetParent(), parent)
	} else if parent.IsVanillaFor() {
		node.ReplaceWith(IR.Empty())
	} else if parent.IsObjectPattern() {
		node.Detach()
	} else if parent.IsArrayPattern() {
		if node == parent.GetLastChild() {
			node.Detach()
		} else {
			node.ReplaceWith(IR.Empty())
		}
	} else if parent.IsDestructuringLhs() {
		node.Detach()
		if parent.GetParent().HasChildren() {
			RemoveChild(parent.GetParent(), parent)
		}
	} else if parent.IsRest() {
		parent.Detach()
	} else if parent.IsParamList() {
		node.Detach()
	} else if parent.IsImport() {
		if node == parent.GetFirstChild() {
			node.ReplaceWith(IR.Empty())
		} else {
			panic(NewIllegalStateException("Invalid attempt to remove: " + node + " from " + parent))
		}
	} else {
		panic(NewIllegalStateException("Invalid attempt to remove node: " + node + " of " + parent))
	}
}

// Replace the child of a var/let/const declaration (usually a name) with a new statement.
// Preserves the order of side effects for all the other declaration children.
// 
// Param: declChild The name node to be replaced.
// Param: newStatement The statement to replace with.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2377
func ReplaceDeclarationChild(declChild *rhino.Node, newStatement *rhino.Node) {
	CheckArgument(IsNameDeclaration(declChild.GetParent()))
	CheckArgument(nil == newStatement.GetParent())
	decl := declChild.GetParent()
	if decl.HasOneChild() {
		decl.ReplaceWith(newStatement)
	} else if declChild.GetNext() == nil {
		declChild.Detach()
		newStatement.InsertAfter(decl)
	} else if declChild.GetPrevious() == nil {
		declChild.Detach()
		newStatement.InsertBefore(decl)
	} else {
		CheckState(decl.HasMoreThanOneChild())
		newDecl := Newrhino.Node(decl.GetToken()).Srcref(decl)
		for after := declChild.GetNext(); after != nil; after = next {
			next = after.GetNext()
			newDecl.AddChildToBack(after.Detach())
		}
		declChild.Detach()
		newStatement.InsertAfter(decl)
		newDecl.InsertAfter(newStatement)
	}
}

// Add a finally block if one does not exist.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2404
func MaybeAddFinally(tryNode *rhino.Node) {
	CheckState(tryNode.IsTry())
	if !NodeUtil.HasFinally(tryNode) {
		tryNode.AddChildToBack(IR.Block().Srcref(tryNode))
	}
}

// Merge a block with its parent block.
// 
// Param: ignoreBlockScopedDeclarations merge the block regardless of any inner block-scoped
//     declarations that may cause name collisions. use if e.g. the AST is normalized
// Returns: Whether the block was removed.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2418
func TryMergeBlock(block *rhino.Node, ignoreBlockScopedDeclarations bool) bool {
	CheckState(block.IsBlock())
	parent := block.GetParent()
	canMerge := ignoreBlockScopedDeclarations || CanMergeBlock(block)
	if IsStatementBlock(parent) && canMerge {
		previous := block
		for block.HasChildren() {
			child := block.RemoveFirstChild()
			child.InsertAfter(previous)
			previous = child
		}
		block.Detach()
		return true
	} else {
		return false
	}
}

// A check inside a block to see if there are const, let, class, or function declarations to be
// safe and not hoist them into the upper block.
// 
// Returns: Whether the block can be removed
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2444
func CanMergeBlock(block *rhino.Node) bool {
	for c := block.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
		switch c.GetToken() {
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Param: node A node
// Returns: Whether the call is a NEW or CALL node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2469
func IsCallOrNew(node *rhino.Node) bool {
	return node.IsCall() || node.IsNew() || node.IsOptChainCall()
}

// Return a BLOCK node for the given FUNCTION node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2474
func GetFunctionBody(fn *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckArgument(fn.IsFunction(), fn)
	return fn.GetLastChild()
}

// Returns the call target for a call expression, resolving an indirected call (`(0, foo)()`) if
// present.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2483
func GetCallTargetResolvingIndirectCalls(call *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckArgument(call.IsCall() || call.IsNew() || call.IsTaggedTemplateLit(), "must be call, new or tagged-template-literal expression, got %s", call)
	target := call.GetFirstChild()
	if target.IsComma() && target.GetSecondChild().IsQualifiedName() {
		return target.GetSecondChild()
	}
	return target
}

// Is the node a var, const, let, function, or class declaration? See {@link
// #isFunctionDeclaration}, {@link #isClassDeclaration}, and {@link #isNameDeclaration}
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2499
func IsDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return IsNameDeclaration(n) || IsFunctionDeclaration(n) || IsClassDeclaration(n)
}

// Whether this is an assignment to 'exports' that creates named exports.
// 
// <ul>
//   <li>exports = {a, b}; // named export, returns true.
//   <li>exports = 0; // namespace export, returns false.
//   <li>exports = {a: 0, b}; // namespace export, returns false.
// </ul>
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2512
func IsNamedExportsLiteral(objectLiteral *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !objectLiteral.IsObjectLit() || !objectLiteral.HasChildren() {
		return false
	}
	for key := objectLiteral.GetFirstChild(); key != nil; key = key.GetNext() {
		if !key.IsStringKey() || key.IsQuotedStringKey() {
			return false
		}
		if !key.GetFirstChild().IsName() {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Is this node a function declaration? A function declaration is a function that has a name that
// is added to the current scope (i.e. a function that is not part of a expression; see {@link
// #isFunctionExpression}).
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2532
func IsFunctionDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsFunction() && IsDeclarationParent(n.GetParent()) && IsNamedFunction(n)
}

// Is this node a class or object literal member function?
// 
// <p>examples:
// 
// <pre><code>
//   class C {
//     f() {}
//     get x() { return this.x_; }
//     set x(v) { this.x_ = v; }
//     [someExpr]() {}
//   }
//   obj = {
//     f() {}
//     get x() { return this.x_; }
//     set x(v) { this.x_ = v; }
//     [someExpr]() {}
//   }
// </code></pre>
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2559
func IsMethodDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if n.IsFunction() {
		parent := n.GetParent()
		return Switch(parent.GetToken())
	} else {
		return false
	}
}

// Is this a class declaration.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2586
func IsClassDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsClass() && IsDeclarationParent(n.GetParent()) && IsNamedClass(n)
}

// Is this node a hoisted function declaration? A function declaration in the scope root is
// hoisted to the top of the scope. See {@link #isFunctionDeclaration}).
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2594
func IsHoistedFunctionDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if IsFunctionDeclaration(n) {
		parent := n.GetParent()
		return parent.IsScript() || parent.IsModuleBody() || parent.GetParent().IsFunction() || parent.IsExport()
	}
	return false
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2605
func IsBlockScopedFunctionDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !IsFunctionDeclaration(n) {
		return false
	}
	current := n.GetParent()
	for current != nil {
		switch current.GetToken() {
		}
	}
	return false
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2627
func IsFunctionBlock(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsBlock() && n.HasParent() && n.GetParent().IsFunction()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2631
func IsClassStaticBlock(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsBlock() && n.HasParent() && n.GetParent().IsClassMembers()
}

// Is a FUNCTION node a function expression?
// 
// <p>A function expression is a function that:
// 
// <ul>
//   <li>has either no name or a name that is not added to the current scope
//   <li>AND can be manipulated as an expression (assigned to variables, passed to functions,
//       etc.) i.e. It is not a method declaration on a class or object literal.
// </ul>
// 
// <p>Some examples of function expressions:
// 
// <pre>
// (function () {})
// (function f() {})()
// [ function f() {} ]
// var f = function f() {};
// for (function f() {};;) {}
// export default function() {}
// () => 1
// </pre>
// 
// <p>Some examples of functions that are <em>not</em> expressions:
// 
// <pre>
// function f() {}
// if (x); else function f() {}
// for (;;) { function f() {} }
// export default function f() {}
// ({
//   f() {},
//   set x(v) {},
//   get x() {},
//   [expr]() {}
// })
// class {
//   f() {}
//   set x(v) {}
//   get x() {}
//   [expr]() {}
// }
// </pre>
// 
// Param: n A node
// Returns: Whether n is a function used within an expression.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2682
func IsFunctionExpression(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsFunction() && !NodeUtil.IsFunctionDeclaration(n) && !NodeUtil.IsMethodDeclaration(n)
}

// Returns: Whether the node is both a function expression and the function is named.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2689
func IsNamedFunctionExpression(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return NodeUtil.IsFunctionExpression(n) && !n.GetFirstChild().GetString().IsEmpty()
}

// see {@link #isFunctionExpression}
// 
// Param: n A node
// Returns: Whether n is a class used within an expression.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2699
func IsClassExpression(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsClass() && !IsNamedClass(n) || !IsDeclarationParent(n.GetParent())
}

// Returns whether the node is both a class expression and the class is named.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2704
func IsNamedClassExpression(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return NodeUtil.IsClassExpression(n) && n.GetFirstChild().IsName()
}

// Returns whether n is a function with a nonempty name. Differs from {@link
// #isFunctionDeclaration} because the name might in a function expression and not be added to the
// current scope.
// 
// <p>Some named functions include
// 
// <pre>
//   (function f() {})();
//   export default function f() {};
//   function f() {};
//   var f = function f() {};
// </pre>
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2722
func IsNamedFunction(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsFunction() && IsReferenceName(n.GetFirstChild())
}

// see {@link #isNamedFunction}
// 
// Param: n A node
// Returns: Whether n is a named class
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2732
func IsNamedClass(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsClass() && IsReferenceName(n.GetFirstChild())
}

// Returns whether this is a bleeding function (an anonymous named function that bleeds into the
// inner scope).
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2740
func IsBleedingFunctionName(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !n.IsName() || n.GetString().IsEmpty() {
		return false
	}
	parent := n.GetParent()
	return IsFunctionExpression(parent) && n == parent.GetFirstChild()
}

// Determines if a node is a function expression that has an empty body.
// 
// Param: node a node
// Returns: whether the given node is a function expression that is empty
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2754
func IsEmptyFunctionExpression(node *rhino.Node) bool {
	return IsFunctionExpression(node) && IsEmptyBlock(node.GetLastChild())
}

// Returns: Whether a function has a reference to its own "arguments" object.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2761
func DoesFunctionReferenceOwnArgumentsObject(fn *rhino.Node) bool {
	CheckArgument(fn.IsFunction())
	if fn.IsArrowFunction() {
		return false
	}
	return ReferencesArgumentsHelper(fn.GetSecondChild()) || ReferencesArgumentsHelper(fn.GetLastChild())
}

// Returns: Whether any child is a reference to the "arguments" object of the root. Effectively,
//     this includes arrow method bodies (which don't have their own) and excludes other functions
//     which shadow the "arguments" value with their own.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2775
func referencesArgumentsHelper(node *rhino.Node) bool {
	if node.IsName() && node.GetString().Equals("arguments") {
		return true
	}
	if NodeUtil.IsNonArrowFunction(node) {
		return false
	}
	for c := node.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
		if ReferencesArgumentsHelper(c) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// <code>
// a.f(...)
// a?.f(...)
// a['f'](...)
// </code>
// 
// Returns: Whether node is a call to methodName.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2802
func IsObjectCallMethod(callNode *rhino.Node, methodName string) bool {
	if callNode.IsCall() || callNode.IsOptChainCall() {
		callee := callNode.GetFirstChild()
		if IsNormalOrOptChainGetProp(callee) {
			return callee.GetString().Equals(methodName)
		} else if IsNormalOrOptChainGet(callee) {
			last := callee.GetLastChild()
			if last != nil && last.IsStringLit() {
				propName := last.GetString()
				return propName.Equals(methodName)
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

// Returns: Whether the callNode represents an expression in the form of: x.call(...)
//     x['call'](...)
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2822
func IsFunctionObjectCall(callNode *rhino.Node) bool {
	return IsObjectCallMethod(callNode, "call")
}

// Returns: Whether the callNode represents an expression in the form of: x.apply(...)
//     x['apply'](...)
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2830
func IsFunctionObjectApply(callNode *rhino.Node) bool {
	return IsObjectCallMethod(callNode, "apply")
}

// Determines whether this node is strictly on the left hand side of an assign or var
// initialization. Notably, this does not include all L-values, only statements where the node is
// used only as an L-value.
// 
// Param: n The node
// Param: parent Parent of the node
// Returns: True if n is the left hand of an assign
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2843
func IsNameDeclOrSimpleAssignLhs(n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) bool {
	return parent.IsAssign() && parent.GetFirstChild() == n || NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(parent)
}

// Determines whether this node is used as an L-value. Notice that sometimes names are used as
// both L-values and R-values.
// 
// <p>We treat "var x;" and "let x;" as an L-value because it's syntactically similar to "var x =
// undefined", even though it's technically not an L-value. But it kind of makes sense if you
// treat it as "assignment to 'undefined' at the top of the scope".
// 
// Param: n The node
// Returns: True if n is an L-value.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2858
func IsLValue(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
	parent := n.GetParent()
	if parent == nil {
		return false
	}
	return Switch(parent.GetToken())
}

// Determines whether this node is used as an L-value that is a declaration.
// 
// <p><code>x = 5;</code> is an L-value but does not declare a variable.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2886
func IsDeclarationLValue(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	isLValue := IsLValue(n)
	if !isLValue {
		return false
	}
	parent := n.GetParent()
	return Switch(parent.GetToken())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2903
func IsLhsOfAssign(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	return parent != nil && parent.IsAssign() && parent.GetFirstChild() == n
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2908
func IsImportedName(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	return parent.IsImport() || parent.IsImportSpec() && parent.GetLastChild() == n
}

// Returns the node that is effectively declaring the given target.
// 
// <p>Examples:
// 
// <pre><code>
//   const a = 1; // getDeclaringParent(a) returns CONST
//   let {[expression]: [x = 3]} = obj; // getDeclaringParent(x) returns LET
//   function foo({a, b}) {}; // getDeclaringParent(a) returns PARAM_LIST
//   function foo(a = 1) {}; // getDeclaringParent(a) returns PARAM_LIST
//   function foo({a, b} = obj) {}; // getDeclaringParent(a) returns PARAM_LIST
//   function foo(...a) {}; // getDeclaringParent(a) returns PARAM_LIST
//   function foo() {}; // gotRootTarget(foo) returns FUNCTION
//   class foo {}; // gotRootTarget(foo) returns CLASS
//   import foo from './foo'; // getDeclaringParent(foo) returns IMPORT
//   import {foo} from './foo'; // getDeclaringParent(foo) returns IMPORT
//   import {foo as bar} from './foo'; // getDeclaringParent(bar) returns IMPORT
//   } catch (err) { // getDeclaringParent(err) returns CATCH
// </code></pre>
// 
// Param: targetNode a NAME, OBJECT_PATTERN, or ARRAY_PATTERN
// Returns: node of type LET, CONST, VAR, FUNCTION, CLASS, PARAM_LIST, CATCH, or IMPORT
// Throws: IllegalStateException if targetNode is not actually used as a declaration target
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2937
func GetDeclaringParent(targetNode *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	rootTarget := GetRootTarget(targetNode)
	parent := rootTarget.GetParent()
	if parent.IsRest() || parent.IsDefaultValue() {
		parent = parent.GetParent()
		CheckState(parent.IsParamList(), parent)
	} else if parent.IsDestructuringLhs() {
		parent = parent.GetParent()
		CheckState(IsNameDeclaration(parent), parent)
	} else if parent.IsClass() || parent.IsFunction() {
		CheckState(targetNode == parent.GetFirstChild(), targetNode)
	} else if parent.IsImportSpec() {
		CheckState(targetNode == parent.GetSecondChild(), targetNode)
		parent = parent.GetGrandparent()
		CheckState(parent.IsImport(), parent)
	} else {
		CheckState(parent.IsParamList() || IsNameDeclaration(parent) || parent.IsImport() || parent.IsCatch(), parent)
	}
	return parent
}

// Returns the outermost target enclosing the given assignment target.
// 
// <p>Returns targetNode itself if there is no enclosing target.
// 
// <p>Examples:
// 
// <pre><code>
//   const a = 1; // getRootTarget(a) returns a
//   let {[expression]: [x = 3]} = obj; // getRootTarget(x) returns {[expression]: [x = 3]}
//   {a = 1} = obj; // getRootTarget(a) returns {a = 1}
//   {[expression]: [x = 3]} = obj; // getRootTarget(x) returns {[expression]: [x = 3]}
//   function foo({a, b}) {}; // getRootTarget(a) returns {a, b}
//   function foo(a = 1) {}; // getRootTarget(a) returns a
//   function foo({a, b} = obj) {}; // getRootTarget(a) returns a
//   function foo(...a) {}; // getRootTarget(a) returns a
//   function foo() {}; // gotRootTarget(foo) returns foo
//   class foo {}; // gotRootTarget(foo) returns foo
//   import foo from './foo'; // getRootTarget(foo) returns foo
//   import {foo} from './foo'; // getRootTarget(foo) returns foo
//   import {foo as bar} from './foo'; // getRootTarget(bar) returns bar
// </code></pre>
// 
// Throws: IllegalStateException if targetNode is not actually used as a target
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:2999
func GetRootTarget(targetNode *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	enclosingTarget := targetNode
	for nextTarget := GetEnclosingTarget(enclosingTarget); nextTarget != nil; nextTarget = GetEnclosingTarget(enclosingTarget) {
		enclosingTarget = nextTarget
	}
	return enclosingTarget
}

// Returns the immediately enclosing target node for a given target node, or null if none found.
// 
// See: #getRootTarget(Node) for examples
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3014
func getEnclosingTarget(targetNode *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(CheckNotNull(targetNode).IsValidAssignmentTarget(), targetNode)
	parent := CheckNotNull(targetNode.GetParent(), targetNode)
	targetIsFirstChild := parent.GetFirstChild() == targetNode
	if parent.IsDefaultValue() || parent.IsRest() {
		CheckState(targetIsFirstChild, parent)
		targetNode = parent
		parent = CheckNotNull(targetNode.GetParent())
		targetIsFirstChild = targetNode == parent.GetFirstChild()
	}
	switch parent.GetToken() {
	}
}

// Returns true if the node is a lhs value of a destructuring assignment.
// 
// <p>For example, x in {@code var [x] = [1];}, {@code var [...x] = [1];}, and {@code var {a: x} =
// {a: 1}} or a.b in {@code ([a.b] = [1]);} or {@code ({key: a.b} = {key: 1});}
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3115
func IsLhsByDestructuring(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return Switch(n.GetToken())
}

// Returns true if the given node is either an LHS node in a destructuring pattern or if one of
// its descendants contains an LHS node in a destructuring pattern. For example, in {@code var {a:
// b = 3}}}, this returns true given the NAME b or the DEFAULT_VALUE node containing b.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3127
func isLhsByDestructuringHelper(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	grandparent := n.GetGrandparent()
	return Switch(parent.GetToken())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3157
func MayBeObjectLitKey(node *rhino.Node) bool {
	return Switch(node.GetToken())
}

// Determines whether a node represents an object literal key (e.g. key1 in {key1: value1, key2:
// value2}) and is in an object literal. Computed properties are excluded here (see b/111621528).
// 
// Param: node A node
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3170
func IsObjectLitKey(node *rhino.Node) bool {
	return node.GetParent().IsObjectLit() && MayBeObjectLitKey(node)
}

// Get the name of an object literal key.
// 
// Param: key A node
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3179
func GetObjectOrClassLitKeyName(key *rhino.Node) string {
	keyNode := GetObjectOrClassLitKeyNode(key)
	if keyNode != nil {
		return keyNode.GetString()
	}
	panic(NewIllegalStateException("Unexpected node type: " + key))
}

// Get the Node that defines the name of an object literal key.
// 
// Param: key A node
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3192
func GetObjectOrClassLitKeyNode(key *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	switch key.GetToken() {
	}
	panic(NewIllegalStateException("Unexpected node type: " + key))
}

// Determines whether a node represents an object literal get or set key (e.g. key1 in {get key1()
// {}, set key2(a){}).
// 
// Param: node A node
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3214
func IsGetOrSetKey(node *rhino.Node) bool {
	return Switch(node.GetToken())
}

// Converts an operator's token value (see {@link Token}) to a string representation.
// 
// Param: operator the operator's token value to convert
// Returns: the string representation or {@code null} if the token value is not an operator
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3230
func OpToStr(operator rhino.Token) string {
	return Switch(operator)
}

// Converts an operator's token value (see {@link Token}) to a string representation or fails.
// 
// Param: operator the operator's token value to convert
// Returns: the string representation
// Throws: Error if the token value is not an operator
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3288
func OpToStrNoFail(operator rhino.Token) string {
	res := OpToStr(operator)
	if res == nil {
		panic(NewError("Unknown op " + operator))
	}
	return res
}

// Given a node tree, finds all the VAR declarations in that tree that are not in an inner scope.
// Then adds a new VAR node at the top of the current scope that redeclares them, if necessary.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3300
func RedeclareVarsInsideBranch(branch *rhino.Node) {
	if !CanContainHoistedVarsDecls(branch) {
		return
	}
	vars := GetVarsDeclaredInBranch(branch)
	if vars.IsEmpty() {
		return
	}
	parent := GetAddingRoot(branch)
	for _, nameNode := range vars {
		v := IR.Var(IR.Name(nameNode.GetString()).Srcref(nameNode)).Srcref(nameNode)
		CopyNameAnnotations(nameNode, v.GetFirstChild())
		parent.AddChildToFront(v)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3318
func CanContainHoistedVarsDecls(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if NodeUtil.IsStatement(n) {
		return Switch(n.GetToken())
	}
	return true
}

// Copy any annotations that follow a named value.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3329
func CopyNameAnnotations(source *rhino.Node, destination *rhino.Node) {
	if source.GetBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME) {
		destination.PutBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME, true)
	}
}

// Gets a Node at the top of the current scope where we can add new var declarations as children.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3338
func getAddingRoot(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	addingRoot := nil
	ancestor := n
	crawl_ancestors:
	for nil != ancestor {
		switch ancestor.GetToken() {
		}
	}
	CheckState(addingRoot.IsBlock() || addingRoot.IsModuleBody() || addingRoot.IsScript())
	CheckState(!addingRoot.HasChildren() || !addingRoot.GetFirstChild().IsScript())
	return addingRoot
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3364
func NewDeclaration(lhs *rhino.Node, rhs *rhino.Node, declarationType rhino.Token) *rhino.Node {
	if rhs == nil {
		return IR.Declaration(lhs, declarationType)
	}
	return IR.Declaration(lhs, rhs, declarationType)
}

// Creates a node representing a qualified name.
// 
// Param: name A qualified name (e.g. "foo" or "foo.bar.baz")
// Returns: A NAME or GETPROP node
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3377
func NewQName(compiler *Compiler, name string) *rhino.Node {
	endPos := name.IndexOf('.')
	if endPos == -1 {
		endPos = name.Length()
	}
	var qname *rhino.Node
	nodeName := name.Substring(0, endPos)
	if "this".Equals(nodeName) {
		qname = IR.ThisNode()
	} else if "super".Equals(nodeName) {
		qname = IR.SuperNode()
	} else {
		qname = NewName(compiler, nodeName)
	}
	qname.SetLength(endPos)
	for startPos := endPos + 1; endPos < name.Length(); startPos = endPos + 1 {
		endPos = name.IndexOf('.', startPos)
		if endPos == -1 {
			endPos = name.Length()
		}
		part := name.Substring(startPos, endPos)
		qname = IR.Getprop(qname, part)
		if compiler.GetCodingConvention().IsConstantKey(part) {
			qname.PutBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME, true)
		}
		qname.SetLength(part.Length())
	}
	return qname
}

// Creates a node representing a qualified name, copying over the source location information from
// the basis node and assigning the given original name to the node.
// 
// Param: name A qualified name (e.g. "foo" or "foo.bar.baz")
// Param: basisNode The node that represents the name as currently found in the AST.
// Param: originalName The original name of the item being represented by the NAME node. Used for
//     debugging information.
// Returns: A NAME or GETPROP node
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3421
func NewQName(compiler *Compiler, name string, basisNode *rhino.Node, originalName string) *rhino.Node {
	node := NewQName(compiler, name)
	node.SrcrefTreeIfMissing(basisNode)
	if !originalName.Equals(node.GetOriginalName()) {
		node.SetOriginalName(originalName)
	}
	return node
}

// Attaches nameNode to a new qualified name declaration and returns the new qualified declaration
// 
// Returns: a new qualified name declaration
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3439
func GetDeclarationFromName(nameNode *rhino.Node, value *rhino.Node, typ rhino.Token, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) *rhino.Node {
	var result *rhino.Node
	if nameNode.IsName() {
		result = func() any { if value == nil { return IR.Declaration(nameNode, typ) }; return IR.Declaration(nameNode, value, typ) }()
		result.SetJSDocInfo(info)
	} else if value != nil {
		result = IR.ExprResult(IR.Assign(nameNode, value))
		result.GetFirstChild().SetJSDocInfo(info)
	} else {
		result = IR.ExprResult(nameNode)
		result.GetFirstChild().SetJSDocInfo(info)
	}
	return result
}

// Creates a property access on the {@code context} tree.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3456
func NewPropertyAccess(compiler *Compiler, context *rhino.Node, name string) *rhino.Node {
	propNode := IR.Getprop(context, name)
	if compiler.GetCodingConvention().IsConstantKey(name) {
		propNode.PutBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME, true)
	}
	return propNode
}

// Creates a node representing a qualified name.
// 
// Param: name A qualified name (e.g. "foo" or "foo.bar.baz")
// Returns: A VAR node, or an EXPR_RESULT node containing an ASSIGN or NAME node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3470
func NewQNameDeclaration(compiler *Compiler, name string, value *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo) *rhino.Node {
	return NewQNameDeclaration(compiler, name, value, info, Token.VAR)
}

// Creates a node representing a qualified name.
// 
// Param: name A qualified name (e.g. "foo" or "foo.bar.baz")
// Param: type Must be VAR, CONST, or LET. Ignored if {@code name} is dotted.
// Returns: A VAR/CONST/LET node, or an EXPR_RESULT node containing an ASSIGN or NAME node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3482
func NewQNameDeclaration(compiler *Compiler, name string, value *rhino.Node, info *rhino.JSDocInfo, typ rhino.Token) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(typ == Token.VAR || typ == Token.LET || typ == Token.CONST, typ)
	nameNode := NewQName(compiler, name)
	return GetDeclarationFromName(nameNode, value, typ, info)
}

// Gets the root node of a qualified name. Must be either NAME, THIS or SUPER.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3490
func GetRootOfQualifiedName(qName *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	for current := qName; true; current = current.GetFirstChild() {
		if current.IsName() || current.IsThis() || current.IsSuper() {
			return current
		}
		CheckState(current.IsGetProp(), "Not a getprop node:  (%s)", current)
	}
}

// Gets the root node of a string representing a qualified name.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3500
func GetRootOfQualifiedName(qName string) string {
	dot := qName.IndexOf('.')
	if dot == -1 {
		return qName
	}
	return qName.Substring(0, dot)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3508

	nameNode.SetLength(name.Length())
	if compiler.GetCodingConvention().IsConstant(name) {
		nameNode.PutBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME, true)
	}
	return nameNode
}

// Creates a new node representing an *existing* name, copying over the source location

// Test if all characters in the string are in the Basic Latin (aka ASCII) character set - that
// they have UTF-16 values equal to or below 0x7f. This check can find which identifiers with
// Unicode characters need to be escaped in order to allow resulting files to be processed by
// non-Unicode aware UNIX tools and editors. * See
// http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latin_characters_in_Unicode for more on Basic Latin.
// 
// Param: s The string to be checked for ASCII-goodness.
// Returns: True if all characters in the string are in Basic Latin set.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3555
func IsLatin(s string) bool {
	length := s.Length()
	for index := 0; index < length; index++ {
		c := s.CharAt(index)
		if c > LARGEST_BASIC_LATIN {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Determines whether the given name is a valid variable name.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3567
func IsValidSimpleName(name string) bool {
	return TokenStream.IsJSIdentifier(name) && !TokenStream.IsKeyword(name) / / no Unicode escaped characters - some browsers are less tolerant
        // of Unicode characters that might be valid according to the
        // language spec.
        // Note that by this point, Unicode escapes have been converted
        // to UTF-16 characters, so we're only searching for character
        // values, not escapes.
        && isLatin(name)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3579
func (c *NodeUtil) @InlineMe("NodeUtil.isValidQualifiedName(mode.toFeatureSet(), name)" replacement =, mode imports = "com.google.javascript.jscomp.NodeUtil")
  @Deprecated
  public static boolean isValidQualifiedName(LanguageMode, name string) {
	return IsValidQualifiedName(mode.ToFeatureSet(), name)
}

// Determines whether the given name is a valid qualified name.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3588
func IsValidQualifiedName(mode FeatureSet, name string) bool {
	if name.EndsWith(".") || name.StartsWith(".") {
		return false
	}
	parts := Splitter.On('.').SplitToList(name)
	for _, part := range parts {
		if !IsValidPropertyName(mode, part) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return IsValidSimpleName(parts.Get(0))
}

// Determines whether the given name can appear on the right side of the dot operator. Many
// properties (like reserved words) cannot, in ES3.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3606
func IsValidPropertyName(mode FeatureSet, name string) bool {
	if IsValidSimpleName(name) {
		return true
	} else {
		return mode.Has(Feature.KEYWORDS_AS_PROPERTIES) && TokenStream.IsKeyword(name)
	}
}

// Retrieves vars declared in the current node tree, excluding descent scopes.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3626
func GetVarsDeclaredInBranch(root *rhino.Node) []*rhino.Node {
	collector := NewVarCollector()
	VisitPreOrder(root, collector, MATCH_NOT_FUNCTION)
	return collector.vars.Values()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3632
func getLhsNodesHelper(n *rhino.Node, consumer Consumer<Node>) {
	switch n.GetToken() {
	}
}

// Retrieves lhs nodes declared or assigned in a given assigning parent node.
// 
// <p>An assigning parent node is one that assigns a value to one or more LHS nodes.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3674
func VisitLhsNodesInNode(assigningParent *rhino.Node, consumer Consumer<Node>) {
	CheckArgument(IsNameDeclaration(assigningParent) / / e.g. `var [a,b,c];`
            || assigningParent.isParamList() // e.g. `function foo([a,b,c]) {}`
            || isAssignmentOp(assigningParent) // e.g. `[a,b,c] = [4,5,6]`
            || assigningParent.isCatch()
            || assigningParent.isDestructuringLhs()
            || assigningParent.isDefaultValue()
            || assigningParent.isImport()
            // enhanced for loops assign to loop variables
            || isEnhancedFor(assigningParent), assigningParent)
	GetLhsNodesHelper(assigningParent, consumer)
}

// Retrieves lhs nodes declared or assigned in a given destructuring pattern node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3690
func VisitLhsNodesInDestructuringPattern(destructuringPattern *rhino.Node, consumer Consumer<Node>) {
	CheckArgument(destructuringPattern.IsDestructuringPattern(), "Must be a destructuring pattern node.")
	GetLhsNodesHelper(destructuringPattern, consumer)
}

// Returns {@code true} if the node is a definition with Object.defineProperties
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3698
func IsObjectDefinePropertiesDefinition(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !n.IsCall() || !n.HasXChildren(3) {
		return false
	}
	getprop := n.GetFirstChild()
	if !getprop.IsGetProp() {
		return false
	}
	return getprop.GetString().Equals("defineProperties") && IsKnownGlobalObjectReference(getprop.GetFirstChild())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3717
func isKnownGlobalObjectReference(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return Switch(n.GetToken())
}

// Returns {@code true} if the node is a definition with Object.defineProperty.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3726
func IsObjectDefinePropertyDefinition(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !n.IsCall() || !n.HasXChildren(4) {
		return false
	}
	getprop := n.GetFirstChild()
	if !getprop.IsGetProp() {
		return false
	}
	return getprop.GetString().Equals("defineProperty") && IsKnownGlobalObjectReference(getprop.GetFirstChild())
}

// Returns: A list of STRING_KEY properties defined by a Object.defineProperties(o, {...}) call
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3741
func GetObjectDefinedPropertiesKeys(definePropertiesCall *rhino.Node) []*rhino.Node {
	CheckArgument(NodeUtil.IsObjectDefinePropertiesDefinition(definePropertiesCall))
	properties := New[]()
	objectLiteral := definePropertiesCall.GetLastChild()
	for key := objectLiteral.GetFirstChild(); key != nil; key = key.GetNext() {
		if !key.IsStringKey() {
			continue
		}
		properties.Add(key)
	}
	return properties
}

// Returns: {@code true} if the node an assignment to a prototype property of some constructor.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3757
func IsPrototypePropertyDeclaration(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return IsExprAssign(n) && IsPrototypeProperty(n.GetFirstFirstChild())
}

// Returns: Whether the node represents a qualified prototype property.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3764
func IsPrototypeProperty(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !n.IsGetProp() {
		return false
	}
	recv := n.GetFirstChild()
	return recv.IsGetProp() && recv.GetString().Equals("prototype")
}

// Returns: Whether the node represents a prototype method.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3775
func IsPrototypeMethod(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !n.IsFunction() {
		return false
	}
	assignNode := n.GetParent()
	if !assignNode.IsAssign() {
		return false
	}
	return IsPrototypePropertyDeclaration(assignNode.GetParent())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3786
func IsPrototypeAssignment(getProp *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !getProp.IsGetProp() {
		return false
	}
	parent := getProp.GetParent()
	return parent.IsAssign() && getProp.IsFirstChildOf(parent) && getProp.GetString().Equals("prototype")
}

func IsPropertyTest(compiler *Compiler, propAccess *rhino.Node) bool {

	return Switch(parent.GetToken())
}

func IsPropertyAbsenceTest(propAccess *rhino.Node) bool {
	parent := propAccess.GetParent()
	switch parent.GetToken() {

// Param: qName A qualified name node representing a class prototype, or a property on that
//     prototype, e.g. foo.Bar.prototype, or foo.Bar.prototype.toString.
// Returns: The class name part of a qualified prototype name, e.g. foo.Bar.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3843
func GetPrototypeClassName(qName *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	if !qName.IsGetProp() {
		return nil
	}
	if qName.GetString().Equals("prototype") {
		return qName.GetFirstChild()
	}
	recv := qName.GetFirstChild()
	if recv.IsGetProp() && recv.GetString().Equals("prototype") {
		return recv.GetFirstChild()
	}
	return nil
}

// Returns: The string property name part of a qualified prototype name.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3860
func GetPrototypePropertyName(qName *rhino.Node) string {
	qNameStr := qName.GetQualifiedName()
	prototypeIdx := qNameStr.LastIndexOf(".prototype.")
	memberIndex := prototypeIdx + ".prototype".Length() + 1
	return qNameStr.Substring(memberIndex)
}

// Create a node for an empty result expression: "void 0"
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3868
func NewUndefinedNode(srcReferenceNode *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	node := IR.VoidNode(IR.Number(0))
	if srcReferenceNode != nil {
		node.SrcrefTree(srcReferenceNode)
	}
	return node
}

// Create a VAR node containing the given name and initial value expression.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3877
func NewVarNode(name string, value *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	lhs := IR.Name(name)
	if value != nil {
		lhs.Srcref(value)
	}
	return NewVarNode(lhs, value)
}

// Create a VAR node containing the given lhs (name or destructuring pattern) and initial value
// expression.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3889
func NewVarNode(lhs *rhino.Node, value *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	if lhs.IsDestructuringPattern() {
		CheckNotNull(value)
		return IR.Var(Newrhino.Node(Token.DESTRUCTURING_LHS, lhs, value).Srcref(lhs)).Srcref(lhs)
	} else {
		CheckState(lhs.IsName() && !lhs.HasChildren())
		if value != nil {
			lhs.AddChildToBack(value)
		}
		return IR.Var(lhs).Srcref(lhs)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3904
func EmptyFunction() *rhino.Node {
	return IR.Function(IR.Name(""), IR.ParamList(), IR.Block())
}

// Whether the given node's subtree may contain statements, excepting nested functions
// 
// <p>This is useful for traversing all statements in a given script or function without
// traversing into nested functions, so it will return true for e.g. a BLOCK or SWITCH statement.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3961
func IsShallowStatementTree(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n == nil || NodeUtil.IsControlStructure(n) || NodeUtil.IsStatementBlock(n) || n.IsSwitchBody()
}

// Finds the number of times a type is referenced within the node tree.
