func GetNodeTypeReferenceCount(node *rhino.Node, typ rhino.Token, traverseChildrenPred Predicate<Node>) int {
	return GetCount(node, NewMatchNodeType(typ), traverseChildrenPred)
}

// Whether a simple name is referenced within the node tree.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3984
func IsNameReferenced(node *rhino.Node, name string, traverseChildrenPred Predicate<Node>) bool {
	return Has(node, NewMatchNameNode(name), traverseChildrenPred)
}

// Whether a simple name is referenced within the node tree.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3989
func IsNameReferenced(node *rhino.Node, name string) bool {
	return IsNameReferenced(node, name, Predicates.AlwaysTrue())
}

// Finds the number of times a simple name is referenced within the node tree.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:3994
func GetNameReferenceCount(node *rhino.Node, name string) int {
	return GetCount(node, NewMatchNameNode(name), Predicates.AlwaysTrue())
}

// Returns: Whether the predicate is true for the node or any of its descendants.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4001
func Has(node *rhino.Node, pred Predicate<Node>, traverseChildrenPred Predicate<Node>) bool {
	if pred.Apply(node) {
		return true
	}
	if !traverseChildrenPred.Apply(node) {
		return false
	}
	for c := node.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
		if Has(c, pred, traverseChildrenPred) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// Returns the first Node matching the given pred via a pre-order traversal.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4020
func FindPreorder(node *rhino.Node, pred Predicate<Node>, traverseChildrenPred Predicate<Node>) *rhino.Node {
	if pred.Apply(node) {
		return node
	}
	if !traverseChildrenPred.Apply(node) {
		return nil
	}
	for c := node.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
		result := FindPreorder(c, pred, traverseChildrenPred)
		if result != nil {
			return result
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Returns: The number of times the predicate is true for the node or any of its descendants.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4043
func GetCount(n *rhino.Node, pred Predicate<Node>, traverseChildrenPred Predicate<Node>) int {
	total := 0
	if pred.Apply(n) {
		total++
	}
	if traverseChildrenPred.Apply(n) {
		for c := n.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
			total += GetCount(c, pred, traverseChildrenPred)
		}
	}
	return total
}

// A pre-order traversal, calling Visitor.visit for each decendent.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4069
func VisitPreOrder(node *rhino.Node, visitor Visitor) {
	VisitPreOrder(node, visitor, Predicates.AlwaysTrue())
}

// A pre-order traversal, calling Visitor.visit for each node in the tree. Children of nodes that
// do not match the predicate will not be visited.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4077
func VisitPreOrder(node *rhino.Node, visitor Visitor, traverseChildrenPred Predicate<Node>) {
	visitor.Visit(node)
	if traverseChildrenPred.Apply(node) {
		for c := node.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
			VisitPreOrder(c, visitor, traverseChildrenPred)
		}
	}
}

// A post-order traversal, calling Visitor.visit for each decendent.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4089
func VisitPostOrder(node *rhino.Node, visitor Visitor) {
	VisitPostOrder(node, visitor, Predicates.AlwaysTrue())
}

// A post-order traversal, calling Visitor.visit for each node in the tree. Children of nodes that
// do not match the predicate will not be visited.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4097
func VisitPostOrder(node *rhino.Node, visitor Visitor, traverseChildrenPred Predicate<Node>) {
	if traverseChildrenPred.Apply(node) {
		for c := node.GetFirstChild(); c != nil;  {
			next := c.GetNext()
			VisitPostOrder(c, visitor, traverseChildrenPred)
			c = next
		}
	}
	visitor.Visit(node)
}

// Create an {@link Iterable} over the given node and all descendents. Nodes are given in
// depth-first pre-order (<a
// href="https://www.w3.org/TR/DOM-Level-2-Traversal-Range/glossary.html#dt-documentorder">
// document source order</a>).
// 
// <p>This has the benefit over the visitor patten that it is iterative and can be used with Java
// 8 Stream API for searching, filtering, transforms, and other functional processing.
// 
// <p>The given predicate determines whether a node's children will be iterated over. If a node
// does not match the predicate, none of its children will be visited.
// 
// See: java.util.stream.Stream
// See: Streams#stream(Iterable)
// Param: root Root of the tree.
// Param: travserseNodePredicate Matches nodes in the tree whose children should be traversed.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4127
func PreOrderIterable(root *rhino.Node, travserseNodePredicate Predicate<Node>) []*rhino.Node {
	return  - > new PreOrderIterator(root, travserseNodePredicate)
}

// Same as {@link #preOrderIterable(Node, Predicate)} but iterates over all nodes in the tree
// without exception.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4135
func PreOrderIterable(root *rhino.Node) []*rhino.Node {
	return PreOrderIterable(root, // Traverse all nodes.
        Predicates.alwaysTrue())
}

// Returns: Whether an EXPORT node has a from clause.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4202
func IsExportFrom(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	CheckArgument(n.IsExport())
	return n.HasTwoChildren()
}

// Returns: Whether a TRY node has a finally block.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4210
func HasFinally(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	CheckArgument(n.IsTry())
	return n.HasXChildren(3)
}

// Returns: The BLOCK node containing the CATCH node (if any) of a TRY.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4218
func GetCatchBlock(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckArgument(n.IsTry())
	return n.GetSecondChild()
}

// Returns: Whether BLOCK (from a TRY node) contains a CATCH.
// See: NodeUtil#getCatchBlock
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4227
func HasCatchHandler(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	CheckArgument(n.IsBlock())
	return n.HasChildren() && n.GetFirstChild().IsCatch()
}

// Param: fnNode The function.
// Returns: The Node containing the Function parameters.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4236
func GetFunctionParameters(fnNode *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	CheckArgument(fnNode.IsFunction())
	return fnNode.GetSecondChild()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4241
func IsConstantVar(node *rhino.Node, scope *TypedScope) bool {
	if IsConstantName(node) {
		return true
	}
	if !node.IsName() || scope == nil {
		return false
	}
	v := scope.GetVar(node.GetString())
	return v != nil && v.IsDeclaredOrInferredConst() || v.IsConst()
}

// Determines whether a variable is constant:
// 
// <ol>
//   <li>In Normalize, any name that matches the {@link CodingConvention#isConstant(String)} is
//       annotated with an IS_CONSTANT_NAME property.
// </ol>
// 
// Param: node A NAME or STRING node
// Returns: True if a name node represents a constant variable
//     <p>TODO(dimvar): this method and the next two do similar but not quite identical things.
//     Clean up
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4267
func IsConstantName(node *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.node.GetBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME)
}

// Returns whether the given name is constant by coding convention.
// 
// Deprecated: we want to delete the constant by convention logic - see http://b/135755127
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4277
func IsConstantByConvention(convention CodingConvention, node *rhino.Node) bool {
	if IsNormalOrOptChainGetProp(node) {
		return convention.IsConstantKey(node.GetString())
	} else if MayBeObjectLitKey(node) {
		return convention.IsConstantKey(node.GetString())
	} else if node.IsName() {
		return convention.IsConstant(node.GetString())
	}
	return false
}

// Determines whether the given lvalue is declared constant or is a name assigned exactly once.
// 
// <p>Note that this intentionally excludes variables that are constant according to the coding
// convention.
// 
// Param: node some lvalue node.
// Throws: IllegalStateException if the given node is not an lvalue
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4297
func IsConstantDeclaration(info *rhino.JSDocInfo, node *rhino.Node) bool {
	if IsObjectLitKey(node) || node.GetParent().IsAssign() && node.IsFirstChildOf(node.GetParent()) || node.GetParent().IsExprResult() && IsNormalGet(node) || node.IsMemberFieldDef() || node.IsComputedFieldDef() || node.IsComputedProp() {
		return info != nil && info.IsConstant()
	}
	CheckArgument(node.IsName(), node)
	declaringParent := GetDeclaringParent(node)
	if declaringParent.IsConst() {
		return true
	} else if info != nil && info.IsConstant() {
		return true
	}
	return node.IsInferredConstantVar()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4316
func FunctionHasInlineJsdocs(fn *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !fn.IsFunction() {
		return false
	}
	if fn.GetFirstChild().GetJSDocInfo() != nil {
		return true
	}
	param := fn.GetSecondChild().GetFirstChild()
	for param != nil {
		if param.GetJSDocInfo() != nil {
			return true
		}
		param = param.GetNext()
	}
	return false
}

// Param: n The node.
// Returns: The source name property on the node or its ancestors.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4339
func GetSourceName(n *rhino.Node) string {
	sourceName := nil
	for sourceName == nil && n != nil {
		sourceName = n.GetSourceFileName()
		n = n.GetParent()
	}
	return sourceName
}

// Param: n The node.
// Returns: The source name property on the node or its ancestors.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4352
func GetSourceFile(n *rhino.Node) string {
	sourceName := nil
	for sourceName == nil && n != nil {
		sourceName = n.GetStaticSourceFile()
		n = n.GetParent()
	}
	return sourceName
}

// Param: n The node.
// Returns: The InputId property on the node or its ancestors.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4365
func GetInputId(n *rhino.Node) InputId {
	for n != nil && !n.IsScript() {
		n = n.GetParent()
	}
	return func() any { if n != nil && n.IsScript() { return n.GetInputId() }; return nil }()
}

// A new CALL node with the "FREE_CALL" set based on call target.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4374
func NewCallNode(callTarget *rhino.Node, parameters []*rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	isFreeCall := !IsNormalGet(callTarget)
	call := IR.Call(callTarget)
	call.PutBooleanProp(Node.FREE_CALL, isFreeCall)
	for _, parameter := range parameters {
		call.AddChildToBack(parameter)
	}
	return call
}

// Whether the result of the expression node is known to be a primitive value or an object that
// has not yet escaped.
// 
// <p>This guarantee is different than that provided by isLiteralValue (where literal values are
// immune to side-effects if unescaped) or isImmutableValue (which can be safely aliased).
// 
// <p>The concept of "local values" allow for the containment of side-effect operations. For
// example, setting a property on a local value does not produce a global side-effect.
// 
// <p>Note that the concept of "local value" is not deep, it does not say anything about the
// properties of the "local value" (all class instances have "constructor" properties that are not
// local values for instance).
// 
// <p>Note that this method only provides the starting state of the expression result, it does not
// guarantee that the value is forever a local value. If the containing method has any non-local
// side-effect, "local values" may escape.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4402
func EvaluatesToLocalValue(value *rhino.Node) bool {
	switch value.GetToken() {
	}
}

// Returns: Whether the provided expression is may evaluate to 'undefined'.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4484
func MayBeUndefined(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return !IsDefinedValue(n)
}

func IsDefinedValue(value *rhino.Node) bool {

	}

// Given the first sibling, this returns the nth sibling or null if no such sibling exists. This
// is like "getChildAtIndex" but returns null for non-existent indexes.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4571
func getNthSibling(first *rhino.Node, index int) *rhino.Node {
	sibling := first
	for index != 0 && sibling != nil {
		sibling = sibling.GetNext()
		index--
	}
	return sibling
}

// Given the function, this returns the nth argument or null if no such parameter exists.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4581
func GetArgumentForFunction(function *rhino.Node, index int) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(function.IsFunction())
	return GetNthSibling(function.GetSecondChild().GetFirstChild(), index)
}

// Given the new or call, this returns the nth argument of the call or null if no such argument
// exists.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4590
func GetArgumentForCallOrNew(call *rhino.Node, index int) *rhino.Node {
	CheckState(IsCallOrNew(call))
	return GetNthSibling(call.GetSecondChild(), index)
}

// Returns whether this is a target of a call or new.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4596
func IsInvocationTarget(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	return parent != nil && IsCallOrNew(parent) || parent.IsTaggedTemplateLit() && parent.GetFirstChild() == n
}

// Returns whether this is a call (including tagged template lits) or new.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4604
func IsInvocation(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return IsCallOrNew(n) || n.IsTaggedTemplateLit()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4608
func IsCallOrNewArgument(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	return parent != nil && IsCallOrNew(parent) && parent.GetFirstChild() != n
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4613
func isToStringMethodCall(call *rhino.Node) bool {
	getNode := call.GetFirstChild()
	var name string
	if IsNormalOrOptChainGetProp(getNode) {
		name = getNode.GetString()
	} else if IsNormalOrOptChainGet(getNode) {
		propNode := getNode.GetLastChild()
		if !propNode.IsStringLit() {
			return false
		}
		name = propNode.GetString()
	} else {
		return false
	}
	return "toString".Equals(name)
}

// Return declared JSDoc type for the given name declaration, or null if none present.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4632
func GetDeclaredTypeExpression(declaration *rhino.Node) *rhino.JSTypeExpression {
	CheckArgument(declaration.IsName() || declaration.IsStringKey())
	nameJsdoc := GetBestJSDocInfo(declaration)
	if nameJsdoc != nil {
		return nameJsdoc.GetType()
	}
	parent := declaration.GetParent()
	if parent.IsRest() || parent.IsDefaultValue() {
		parent = parent.GetParent()
	}
	if parent.IsParamList() {
		functionJsdoc := GetBestJSDocInfo(parent.GetParent())
		if functionJsdoc != nil {
			return functionJsdoc.GetParameterType(declaration.GetString())
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Find the best JSDoc for the given node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4652
func GetBestJSDocInfo(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.JSDocInfo {
	jsdocNode := GetBestJSDocInfoNode(n)
	return func() any { if jsdocNode == nil { return nil }; return jsdocNode.GetJSDocInfo() }()
}

// Find the best JSDocInfo node for the given node. This version is stricter than {@code
// getBestJSDocInfoNode} in that it only accepts a node that is either a lhs "let, const, var"
// name node, or a RHS class/function, or a class/function declaration, or an export.
// 
// Throws: IllegalStateException if any other input node token is provided.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4664
func GetBestJsDocInfoNodeStrict(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	isDeclaredName := n.IsName() && NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(n.GetParent())
	if isDeclaredName {
		return GetBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n)
	}
	isDeclaredClass := NodeUtil.IsClassDeclaration(n)
	if isDeclaredClass {
		return GetBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n)
	}
	isDeclaredFunction := NodeUtil.IsFunctionDeclaration(n)
	if isDeclaredFunction {
		return GetBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n)
	}
	isRhsClass := IsRhsClass(n)
	if isRhsClass {
		return GetBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n)
	}
	isRhsFunction := IsRhsFunction(n)
	if isRhsFunction {
		return GetBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n)
	}
	isRhsClassName := n.IsName() && IsRhsClass(n.GetParent())
	if isRhsClassName {
		return GetBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n)
	}
	isRhsFunctionName := n.IsName() && IsRhsFunction(n.GetParent())
	if isRhsFunctionName {
		return GetBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n)
	}
	isExport := n.IsExport()
	if isExport {
		return GetBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n)
	}
	panic(NewIllegalStateException("Not allowed to get JSDocInfo node for node: " + n))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4701
func isRhsClass(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return NodeUtil.IsNamedClassExpression(n) && n.GetParent().IsName() || n.GetParent().IsAssign()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4707
func isRhsFunction(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return NodeUtil.IsNamedFunctionExpression(n) && n.GetParent().IsName() || n.GetParent().IsAssign()
}

// Find the best JSDocInfo node for the given node.
// 
// Deprecated: because we want to control the input node tokens accepted by this function. Use
//     {@code getBestJSDocInfoNodeStrict} instead.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4719
func GetBestJSDocInfoNode(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	return GetBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4723
func getBestJsDocInfoNodeInternal(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	if n.IsExprResult() {
		return GetBestJSDocInfoNode(n.GetFirstChild())
	}
	info := n.GetJSDocInfo()
	if info == nil {
		parent := n.GetParent()
		if parent == nil || n.IsExprResult() {
			return nil
		}
		if parent.IsName() || parent.IsExport() || parent.IsVar() || parent.IsLet() || parent.IsConst() || parent.IsDeclare() {
			return GetBestJSDocInfoNode(parent)
		} else if parent.IsAssign() {
			return GetBestJSDocInfoNode(parent)
		} else if MayBeObjectLitKey(parent) || parent.IsComputedProp() {
			return parent
		} else if parent.IsFunction() || parent.IsClass() && n == parent.GetFirstChild() {
			return GetBestJSDocInfoNode(parent)
		} else if NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(parent) && parent.HasOneChild() {
			return parent
		} else if parent.IsHook() && parent.GetFirstChild() != n || parent.IsOr() || parent.IsAnd() || parent.IsComma() && parent.GetFirstChild() != n {
			return GetBestJSDocInfoNode(parent)
		}
	}
	return n
}

// Find the l-value that the given r-value is being assigned to.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4761
func GetBestLValue(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	if IsFunctionDeclaration(n) || IsClassDeclaration(n) {
		return n.GetFirstChild()
	} else if n.IsClassMembers() {
		return GetBestLValue(parent)
	} else if parent.IsName() {
		return parent
	} else if parent.IsAssign() {
		return parent.GetFirstChild()
	} else if MayBeObjectLitKey(parent) || parent.IsComputedProp() {
		return parent
	} else if parent.IsHook() && parent.GetFirstChild() != n || parent.IsOr() || parent.IsAnd() || parent.IsComma() && parent.GetFirstChild() != n {
		return GetBestLValue(parent)
	} else if parent.IsCast() {
		return GetBestLValue(parent)
	}
	return nil
}

// Gets the r-value (or initializer) of a node returned by getBestLValue.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4785
func GetRValueOfLValue(n *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	switch parent.GetToken() {
	}
	return nil
}

// Get the owner of the given l-value node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4840
func GetBestLValueOwner(lValue *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	if lValue == nil || lValue.GetParent() == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if MayBeObjectLitKey(lValue) || lValue.IsComputedProp() {
		return GetBestLValue(lValue.GetParent())
	} else if IsNormalGet(lValue) {
		return lValue.GetFirstChild()
	}
	return nil
}

// Get the name of the given l-value node.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4854
func GetBestLValueName(lValue *rhino.Node) string {
	if lValue == nil || lValue.GetParent() == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if lValue.GetParent().IsClassMembers() && !lValue.IsComputedProp() {
		className := NodeUtil.GetName(lValue.GetGrandparent())
		if className == nil {
			return nil
		}
		methodName := lValue.GetString()
		maybePrototype := func() any { if lValue.IsStaticMember() { return "." }; return ".prototype." }()
		return className + maybePrototype + methodName
	}
	if MayBeObjectLitKey(lValue) {
		owner := GetBestLValue(lValue.GetParent())
		if owner != nil {
			ownerName := GetBestLValueName(owner)
			if ownerName != nil {
				key := GetObjectOrClassLitKeyName(lValue)
				return func() any { if TokenStream.IsJSIdentifier(key) { return ownerName + "." + key }; return nil }()
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	return lValue.GetQualifiedName()
}

// Gets the root of a qualified name l-value.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4884
func GetBestLValueRoot(lValue *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	if lValue == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return Switch(lValue.GetToken())
}

// Param: n The expression to check.
// Returns: Whether the expression is unconditionally executed only once in the containing
//     execution scope.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:4952
func IsExecutedExactlyOnce(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	inspect:
	for {
		parent := n.GetParent()
		switch parent.GetToken() {
		}
		if !(n != nil) {
			break
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Returns: An appropriate AST node for the boolean value.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5000
func BooleanNode(value bool) *rhino.Node {
	return func() any { if value { return IR.TrueNode() }; return IR.FalseNode() }()
}

// Returns: An appropriate AST node for the double value.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5007
func NumberNode(value float64, srcref *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	var result *rhino.Node
	if Double.IsNaN(value) {
		result = IR.Name("NaN")
		result.PutBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME, true)
	} else {
		if Double.IsInfinite(value) {
			result = IR.Name("Infinity")
			result.PutBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME, true)
		} else {
			result = IR.Number(Math.Abs(value))
		}
		if IsNegative(value) {
			result = IR.Neg(result)
		}
	}
	if srcref != nil {
		result.SrcrefTree(srcref)
	}
	return result
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5029
func IsNaN(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.IsName() && n.GetString().Equals("NaN") || n.GetToken() == Token.DIV && n.GetFirstChild().IsNumber() && n.GetFirstChild().GetDouble() == 0 && n.GetLastChild().IsNumber() && n.GetLastChild().GetDouble() == 0 || n.MatchesQualifiedName(NUMBER_NAN)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5042
func CountAstSizeUpToLimit(n *rhino.Node, limit int) int {
	wrappedSize := {0}
	VisitPreOrder(n, n12 - > wrappedSize[0]++, n1 - > wrappedSize[0] < limit)
	return wrappedSize[0]
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5049
func CountAstSize(n *rhino.Node) int {
	count := 1
	for c := n.GetFirstChild(); c != nil; c = c.GetNext() {
		count += CountAstSize(c)
	}
	return count
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5057
func CreateConstantJsDoc() *rhino.JSDocInfo {
	JSDocInfo.Builder = JSDocInfo.Builder()
	builder.RecordConstancy()
	return builder.Build()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5128
func IsModuleScopeRoot(n *rhino.Node) bool {

}

// Whether the given node is referencing the `exports` object in some goog.module
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5133
func IsGoogModuleExportsReference(scope *TypedScope, possibleName *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !possibleName.IsName() || !possibleName.GetString().Equals("exports") {
		return false
	}
	v := scope.GetVar(possibleName.GetString())
	scopeRoot := func() any { if v != nil { return v.GetScopeRoot() }; return nil }()
	return scopeRoot != nil && scopeRoot.IsModuleBody() || scopeRoot.IsFunction() && IsBundledGoogModuleScopeRoot(GetFunctionBody(scopeRoot))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5147
func IsBundledGoogModuleCall(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !n.IsCall() && n.HasTwoChildren() && GOOG_LOADMODULE.Matches(n.GetFirstChild()) {
		return false
	}
	return n.HasParent() && n.GetParent().IsExprResult() && n.GetGrandparent() != nil && n.GetGrandparent().IsScript()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5159
func IsBundledGoogModuleScopeRoot(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !n.IsBlock() || !n.HasChildren() || !IsGoogModuleCall(n.GetFirstChild()) {
		return false
	}
	function := n.GetParent()
	if function == nil || !function.IsFunction() || !GetFunctionParameters(function).HasOneChild() || !GetFunctionParameters(function).GetFirstChild().MatchesName("exports") {
		return false
	}
	call := function.GetParent()
	if !call.IsCall() || !call.HasTwoChildren() || !GOOG_LOADMODULE.Matches(call.GetFirstChild()) {
		return false
	}
	return call.GetParent().IsExprResult() && call.GetGrandparent().IsScript()
}

		target := n.GetFirstFirstChild()
		return GOOG_MODULE_DECLARE_LEGACY_NAMESPACE.Matches(target)
	}
	return false
}

// Returns: Whether the node is a goog.module file's SCRIPT node.

}

// Returns: Whether the node is a SCRIPT node for a goog.module that has a declareLegacyNamespace
//     call.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5213
func IsLegacyGoogModuleFile(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return IsGoogModuleFile(n) && IsGoogModuleDeclareLegacyNamespaceCall(n.GetFirstChild().GetSecondChild())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5218
func IsConstructor(fnNode *rhino.Node) bool {
	if fnNode == nil || !fnNode.IsFunction() {
		return false
	}
	typ := fnNode.GetJSType()
	jsDocInfo := GetBestJSDocInfo(fnNode)
	color := fnNode.GetColor()
	return typ != nil && typ.IsConstructor() || jsDocInfo != nil && jsDocInfo.IsConstructor() || color != nil && color.IsConstructor() || IsEs6Constructor(fnNode)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5233
func IsEs6ConstructorMemberFunctionDef(memberFunctionDef *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !memberFunctionDef.IsMemberFunctionDef() {
		return false
	}
	return memberFunctionDef.GetParent().IsClassMembers() / / is in a class
        && !memberFunctionDef.isStaticMember() // constructors aren't static
        && memberFunctionDef.getString().equals("constructor")
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5242
func IsEs6Constructor(fnNode *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !fnNode.IsFunction() {
		return false
	}
	memberFunctionDef := fnNode.GetParent()
	return memberFunctionDef != nil && IsEs6ConstructorMemberFunctionDef(memberFunctionDef)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5250
func IsGetterOrSetter(propNode *rhino.Node) bool {
	if IsGetOrSetKey(propNode) {
		return true
	}
	if !propNode.IsStringKey() || !propNode.GetFirstChild().IsFunction() {
		return false
	}
	keyName := propNode.GetString()
	return keyName.Equals("get") || keyName.Equals("set")
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5261
func IsCallTo(n *rhino.Node, qualifiedName string) bool {
	return n.IsCall() && n.GetFirstChild().MatchesQualifiedName(qualifiedName)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5265
func IsCallTo(n *rhino.Node, qualifiedName QualifiedName) bool {
	return n.IsCall() && qualifiedName.Matches(n.GetFirstChild())
}

// A faster version of {@link #isCallTo(Node, String)}.
// 
// Param: n node to check if a call
// Param: targetMethod the prebuilt AST getprop node that represents the method to check
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5275
func IsCallTo(n *rhino.Node, targetMethod *rhino.Node) bool {
	if !n.IsCall() {
		return false
	}
	return n.GetFirstChild().MatchesQualifiedName(targetMethod)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5283
func CollectExternVariableNames(compiler *Compiler, externs *rhino.Node) map[string]struct{} {
	externsRefs := NewReferenceCollector(compiler, ReferenceCollector.DO_NOTHING_BEHAVIOR, NewSyntacticScopeCreator(compiler))
	externsRefs.Process(externs)
	ImmutableSet.Builder < String > externsNames = ImmutableSet.Builder()
	for _, v := range externsRefs.GetAllSymbols() {
		if !v.IsParam() {
			externsNames.Add(v.GetName())
		}
	}
	return externsNames.Build()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5298
func CreateSynthesizedExternsSymbol(compiler *Compiler, nameToAdd string) {
	name := IR.Name(nameToAdd)
	name.PutBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME, true)
	v := IR.Var(name)
	input := compiler.GetSynthesizedExternsInput()
	root := input.GetAstRoot(compiler)
	name.SetStaticSourceFileFrom(root)
	v.SetStaticSourceFileFrom(root)
	root.AddChildToBack(v)
	compiler.ReportChangeToEnclosingScope(v)
}

// Recurses through a tree, marking all function nodes as changed.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5311
func MarkNewScopesChanged(node *rhino.Node, compiler *Compiler) {
	compiler.GetChangeTracker().MarkNewScopesChanged(node)
}

// Recurses through a tree, marking all function nodes deleted.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5316
func MarkFunctionsDeleted(node *rhino.Node, compiler *Compiler) {
	if node.IsFunction() {
		compiler.ReportFunctionDeleted(node)
	}
	for child := node.GetFirstChild(); child != nil; child = child.GetNext() {
		MarkFunctionsDeleted(child, compiler)
	}
	shadowed := node.GetClosureUnawareShadow()
	if shadowed != nil {
		MarkFunctionsDeleted(shadowed, compiler)
	}
}

// Returns the list of scope nodes which are parents of the provided list of scope nodes.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5332
func GetParentChangeScopeNodes(scopeNodes []*rhino.Node) []*rhino.Node {
	parentScopeNodes := Newmap[]struct{}(scopeNodes)
	for _, scopeNode := range scopeNodes {
		parentScopeNodes.Add(ChangeTracker.GetEnclosingChangeScopeRoot(scopeNode))
	}
	return New[](parentScopeNodes)
}

// Removes any scope nodes from the provided list that are nested within some other scope node
// also in the list. Returns the modified list.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5344
func RemoveNestedChangeScopeNodes(scopeNodes []*rhino.Node) []*rhino.Node {
	uniqueScopeNodes := Newmap[]struct{}(scopeNodes)
	for _, scopeNode := range scopeNodes {
		for ancestor := scopeNode.GetParent(); ancestor != nil; ancestor = ancestor.GetParent() {
			if ChangeTracker.IsChangeScopeRoot(ancestor) && uniqueScopeNodes.Contains(ancestor) {
				uniqueScopeNodes.Remove(scopeNode)
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return New[](uniqueScopeNodes)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5359
func GetInvocationArgsAsIterable(invocation *rhino.Node) []*rhino.Node {
	if invocation.IsTaggedTemplateLit() {
		return NewTemplateArgsIterable(invocation.GetLastChild())
	}
	CheckState(IsCallOrNew(invocation), invocation)
	if invocation.HasOneChild() {
		return ImmutableList.Of()
	}
	ImmutableList.Builder < Node > list = ImmutableList.Builder()
	for arg := invocation.GetSecondChild(); arg != nil; arg = arg.GetNext() {
		list.Add(arg)
	}
	return list.Build()
}

// Returns the number of arguments in this invocation. For template literals it takes into account
// the implicit first argument of ITemplateArray
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5380
func GetInvocationArgsCount(invocation *rhino.Node) int {
	if invocation.IsTaggedTemplateLit() {
		args := NewTemplateArgsIterable(invocation.GetLastChild())
		return Iterables.Size(args) + 1
	} else {
		return invocation.GetChildCount() - 1
	}
}

// Records a mapping of names to vars of everything reachable in a module. Should only be called
// with a module scope.
// 
// Param: nameVarMap an empty map that gets populated with the keys being variable names and
//     values being variable objects
// Param: orderedVars an empty list that gets populated with variable objects in the order that
//     they appear in the module
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5432
func GetAllVarNamesDeclaredInModule(moduleNode *rhino.Node, compiler *Compiler, scopeCreator ScopeCreator, globalScope *TypedScope) map[string]struct{} {
	CheckState(moduleNode.IsModuleBody(), "getAllVarsDeclaredInModule expects a module body node")
	CheckState(globalScope.IsGlobal(), globalScope)
	nameVars := Newmap[]struct{}()
	finder := NewScopedCallback()
	NodeTraversal.Builder().SetCompiler(compiler).SetCallback(finder).SetScopeCreator(scopeCreator).TraverseWithScope(moduleNode, globalScope)
	return nameVars
}

// Returns a mapping of names to vars of everything reachable in a function. Should only be called
// with a function scope. Does not enter new control flow areas aka embedded functions.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5478
func GetAllVarsDeclaredInFunction(compiler *Compiler, scopeCreator ScopeCreator, scope *TypedScope) AllVarsDeclaredInFunction {
	CheckState(scope.IsFunctionScope(), scope)
	nameVarMap := NewLinkedHashMap<>()
	orderedVars := New[]()
	finder := NewScopedCallback()
	NodeTraversal.Builder().SetCompiler(compiler).SetCallback(finder).SetScopeCreator(scopeCreator).TraverseAtScope(scope)
	return NewAllVarsDeclaredInFunction(nameVarMap, orderedVars)
}

// Returns true if the node is a property of an object literal.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5539
func IsObjLitProperty(node *rhino.Node) bool {
	return node.IsStringKey() || node.IsGetterDef() || node.IsSetterDef() || node.IsMemberFunctionDef() || node.IsComputedProp()
}

// Returns: Whether the node represents the return value of a blockless Arrow function
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5550
func IsBlocklessArrowFunctionResult(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	parent := n.GetParent()
	return parent != nil && parent.IsFunction() && n == parent.GetLastChild() && !n.IsBlock()
}

// Returns a script node's FeatureSet, which is set at parse-time. This may not be up-to-date as
// passes can add/remove features from a script node's descendants.
// 
// <p>The feature set will be null if the script node was created artificially or if the parser
// didn't detect any interesting features.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5562
func GetFeatureSetOfScript(scriptNode *rhino.Node) FeatureSet {
	CheckState(scriptNode.IsScript(), scriptNode)
	return FeatureSet(scriptNode.GetProp(Node.FEATURE_SET))
}

// Adds the given features to a SCRIPT node's FeatureSet property.
// 
// <p>Also updates the compiler's FeatureSet.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5572
func AddFeatureToScript(scriptNode *rhino.Node, feature Feature, compiler *Compiler) {
	CheckState(scriptNode.IsScript(), scriptNode)
	currentFeatures := GetFeatureSetOfScript(scriptNode)
	newFeatures := func() any { if currentFeatures != nil { return currentFeatures.With(feature) }; return FeatureSet.BARE_MINIMUM.With(feature) }()
	scriptNode.PutProp(Node.FEATURE_SET, newFeatures)
	if feature != Feature.MODULES {
		CheckState(compiler.GetAllowableFeatures().Contains(feature), "Cannot add feature: %s. It is not supported in the output language, and either 1) its" + " corresponding transpilation pass has already run or 2) transpilation of this" + " feature is unsupported entirely", feature)
	} else {
		compiler.SetAllowableFeatures(compiler.GetAllowableFeatures().With(feature))
	}
}

// Removes the given feature from the SCRIPT node's FeatureSet property.
// 
// <p>Removing a feature from a single script does not mean that it's removed from all scripts.
// Hence this method does not remove it from the compiler's featureSet. The caller must remove it
// from the compiler's featureSet if it's calling this method for each script.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5601
func removeFeatureFromScript(scriptNode *rhino.Node, feature Feature) {
	currentFeatures := GetFeatureSetOfScript(scriptNode)
	if currentFeatures != nil {
		currentFeatures = currentFeatures.Without(feature)
	}
	scriptNode.PutProp(Node.FEATURE_SET, currentFeatures)
}

// Removes the given featureSet from the SCRIPT node's FeatureSet property.
// 
// <p>Removing a feature from a single script does not mean that it's removed from all scripts.
// Hence this method does not remove it from the compiler's featureSet. The caller must remove it
// from the compiler's featureSet using {@code AbstractCompiler.markFeatureSetNotAllowed} or
// {@code AbstractCompiler.markFeatureNotAllowed} if it's calling this method for each script.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5617
func RemoveFeaturesFromScript(scriptNode *rhino.Node, featureSet FeatureSet) {
	currentFeatures := GetFeatureSetOfScript(scriptNode)
	if currentFeatures != nil {
		currentFeatures = currentFeatures.Without(featureSet)
		scriptNode.PutProp(Node.FEATURE_SET, currentFeatures)
	}
}

// Removes the given feature from the FEATURE_SET prop of all SCRIPT nodes under root.
// 
// <p>Also updates the compiler's FeatureSet.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5630
func RemoveFeatureFromAllScripts(root *rhino.Node, feature Feature, compiler *Compiler) {
	CheckArgument(root.IsRoot(), root)
	for childNode := root.GetFirstChild(); childNode != nil; childNode = childNode.GetNext() {
		CheckState(childNode.IsScript())
		NodeUtil.RemoveFeatureFromScript(childNode, feature)
	}
	compiler.MarkFeatureNotAllowed(feature)
}

// Removes the given feature from the FEATURE_SET prop of all SCRIPT nodes under root.
// 
// <p>Also updates the compiler's FeatureSet.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5646
func RemoveFeaturesFromAllScripts(root *rhino.Node, featureSet FeatureSet, compiler *Compiler) {
	CheckArgument(root.IsRoot(), root)
	for childNode := root.GetFirstChild(); childNode != nil; childNode = childNode.GetNext() {
		CheckState(childNode.IsScript())
		NodeUtil.RemoveFeaturesFromScript(childNode, featureSet)
	}
	compiler.MarkFeatureSetNotAllowed(featureSet)
}

// Adds the given feature to the FEATURE_SET prop of all scripts under externs and root.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5659
func AddFeatureToAllScripts(root *rhino.Node, feature Feature, compiler *Compiler) {
	CheckArgument(root.IsRoot(), root)
	for childNode := root.GetFirstChild(); childNode != nil; childNode = childNode.GetNext() {
		CheckState(childNode.IsScript())
		NodeUtil.AddFeatureToScript(childNode, feature, compiler)
	}
}

// Adds the given features to a SCRIPT node's FeatureSet property.
// 
// <p>Also updates the compiler's FeatureSet.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5674
func AddFeaturesToScript(scriptNode *rhino.Node, features FeatureSet, compiler *Compiler) {
	CheckState(scriptNode.IsScript(), scriptNode)
	for _, feature := range features.GetFeatures() {
		AddFeatureToScript(scriptNode, feature, compiler)
	}
}

// Calls {@code cb} with all NAMEs declared in a PARAM_LIST or destructuring pattern.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5682
func GetParamOrPatternNames(n *rhino.Node, cb Consumer<Node>) {
	n.ParsingUtil.GetParamOrPatternNames(n, cb)
}

// Represents a goog.require'd namespace and property inside a module.
// 
// Param: namespace The Closure namespace inside the require call
// Param: property The property off the required namespace. Needed only for destructuring
//     requires.
// Param: isStrongRequire true if the require is a goog.require, false if it is a goog.requireType
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5694
func (c *NodeUtil) GoogRequire(namespace string, property string, isStrongRequire bool) record {
	// TODO: public GoogRequire {
	RequireNonNull(namespace, "namespace")
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5709
func GetGoogRequireInfo(name string, scope *TypedScope) GoogRequire {
	v := scope.GetVar(name)
	if v == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return GetGoogRequireInfo(v)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5717
func GetGoogRequireInfo(v Var) GoogRequire {
	CheckNotNull(v)
	if !v.GetScopeRoot().IsModuleBody() || v.GetNameNode() == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return GetGoogRequireInfo(v.GetNameNode())
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5726
func GetGoogRequireInfo(nameNode *rhino.Node) GoogRequire {
	if nameNode.IsImportStar() {
		return nil
	}
	CheckState(nameNode.IsName(), "unexpected node type: %s", nameNode)
	if NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(nameNode.GetParent()) {
		requireCall := nameNode.GetFirstChild()
		if requireCall == nil {
			return nil
		}
		isStrongRequire := IsGoogRequireCall(requireCall)
		if !isStrongRequire || IsGoogRequireTypeCall(requireCall) {
			return nil
		}
		namespace := requireCall.GetSecondChild().GetString()
		return GoogRequire.FromNamespace(namespace, isStrongRequire)
	} else if nameNode.GetParent().IsStringKey() && nameNode.GetGrandparent().IsObjectPattern() {
		requireCall := nameNode.GetGrandparent().GetNext()
		if requireCall == nil {
			return nil
		}
		isStrongRequire := IsGoogRequireCall(requireCall)
		if !isStrongRequire || IsGoogRequireTypeCall(requireCall) {
			return nil
		}
		property := nameNode.GetParent().GetString()
		namespace := requireCall.GetSecondChild().GetString()
		return GoogRequire.FromNamespaceAndProperty(namespace, property, isStrongRequire)
	}
	return nil
}

// Estimates the number of lines in the file of this script node.
// 
// <p>This method returns the line number of the last node in the script +1. This is not strictly
// the number of lines in the file (consider trailing comments or whitespace), but should be
// strongly correlated with it. If perfect accuracy is desired the original source file will have
// to be read.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:5768
func EstimateNumLines(scriptNode *rhino.Node) int {
	CheckArgument(scriptNode.IsScript())
	current := scriptNode
	for current.HasChildren() {
		current = current.GetLastChild()
	}
	return current.GetLineno() + 1
}

// Utility class for {@see #preOrderIterable}. Iterates over nodes in tree in depth-first
// pre-order.
// Inner class NodeUtil.PreOrderIterator — ported as NodeUtilPreOrderIterator.
type NodeUtilPreOrderIterator struct {
	// TODO: Java type Predicate<Node> not mapped
	TraverseNodePredicate Predicate<Node>
	Current *rhino.Node
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:7
func (c *NodeUtilPreOrderIterator) PreOrderIterator(root *rhino.Node, traverseNodePredicate Predicate<Node>) {
	Preconditions.CheckNotNull(root)
	c.traverseNodePredicate = traverseNodePredicate
	c.current = root
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:14
func (c *NodeUtilPreOrderIterator) ComputeNext() *rhino.Node {
	if current == nil {
		return EndOfData()
	}
	returnValue := current
	current = CalculateNextNode(returnValue)
	return returnValue
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java:24
func (n *NodeUtilPreOrderIterator) calculateNextNode(currentNode *rhino.Node) *rhino.Node {
	Preconditions.CheckNotNull(currentNode)
	if traverseNodePredicate.Apply(currentNode) {
		if currentNode.HasChildren() {
			return currentNode.GetFirstChild()
		}
	}
	for currentNode != nil {
		next := currentNode.GetNext()
		if next != nil {
			return next
		}
		currentNode = currentNode.GetParent()
	}
	return nil
}
